description: List the matters you can access, or get one matter's overview. Omit matter_id to list accessible matters (filter with status, page with cursor); list first when the user does not name a matter or you need matter IDs for follow-up tools. Pass matter_id to return that matter's overview instead: counts, recent entities, linked contacts, and members.
name: list_matters
title: List matters

description: Create, update, archive, or unarchive a matter. Omit matter_id to create a new matter (name required; pass client_id to attach a client contact). Pass matter_id to update an existing matter: set name, reference, or billing_reference, and/or set status to 'archived' or 'active' to archive or unarchive it. Returns the matter ID.
name: save_matter
title: Save matter

description: Permanently delete a matter with its documents, tasks, fields and chat history; irreversible. Refused (409) when it has time, expenses or invoices: archive it instead.
name: delete_matter
title: Delete matter

description: Link a contact to a matter in a party role (opposing party/counsel, co-counsel, witness, expert witness, third party, judge, mediator, or other), or remove such a link. Pass contact_id with role to link. To unlink, pass matter_contact_id (precise, from list_matters) or contact_id alone; contact_id alone is rejected when the contact holds several roles on the matter. At the contact limit, unlink an existing matter_contact_id (without role) before linking another contact.
name: link_matter_contact
title: Link contact to matter

description: Grant an organization member matter access.
name: add_matter_member
title: Add matter member

description: Revoke matter access; cancel desktop editing sessions. Reassign work or unassign it. Requires human approval (confirm: true).
name: remove_matter_member
title: Remove matter member

description: Search across all accessible matters. Use this when the user explicitly asks to search outside a single matter or you do not yet know the right matter.
name: search_across_matters
title: Search across matters

description: Search case law. `queries` merges phrasings; matchedQueries names each hit's phrasings. `limit` is split evenly. Facets are opt-in by name, first phrasing on page one only. Totals count full matches; uncounted for multiple phrasings. strict requires every word; otherwise function words are optional. Relevance pages may add some_terms hits after all_terms hits. searches[] reports queryUsed/warnings. source_id uses facets.source values. Use `url` for the reader and `source_url` for the publisher.
name: search_case_law
title: Search case law

description: Report case-law availability per jurisdiction and source: held decision-year ranges, last sync, decisions awaiting text, recorded gaps, court breakdowns. Check before concluding a decision is missing. A listed country not yet admitted, without coverage, returns status unavailable with its reason.
name: case_law_coverage
title: Read case-law coverage

description: Read `decision_ids[]` in order. `page` selects a `max_chars` window; entries give page/pageCount and textSource 'ast'/'fulltext'. Pass textVersion back as text_version; versionChanged flags changed text. `full: true` returns whole text up to 200000 chars. `query` returns matches, neighbours and deep links. Page 1 adds reader/publisher URL, metadata, textFields and citation summaries (top citers may be bounded by 2048 edges). Use read_case_law_citations for all citations. One id adds an outline. `include` picks fields; [] returns text and identity only.
name: read_case_law_decision
title: Read case-law decision

description: Read citations with citing passages. `cited_by` reads citers; `cites` reads citations. Filters `doctrine` and `polarity` combine with AND. `polarity`: 'unclassified' means unread; 'mixed' means mentions disagreed. `doctrine` is reviewed 'distinguishes' or 'limits'; rejected when unavailable. 'not_stated' does not mean followed; 'unread' means none was read; null when `doctrineAvailability` is 'unavailable'. `passage.evidenceQuote` is the verbatim evidence when text is available. `passage.text` is at most 1200 characters, cut when `passage.truncated`; `passage.mention` is 'sole', 'classified_section' (the mention polarity came from) or 'latest_of_several' (it may not be). Pass nextCursor as cursor. Use `url` for the reader and `source_url` for the publisher.
name: read_case_law_citations
title: Read case-law citations

description: Open one decision when the user asks to read or open it. Returns metadata, outline and a small target window. paragraphs names the court's printed numbers (48 or 48-53); url opens the web reader at that range. At most once per answer.
name: open_case_law_decision
title: Open case-law decision

description: Resolve a docket or ECLI; search_case_law handles descriptions. A CZ/SK court in identifier constrains it. otherCourtCandidates are DIFFERENT decisions at other courts, not the requested one; ask the user to choose. Only elsewhere: not_found/not_at_this_court. Unknown court: not_found/court_unrecognized. Resolved gives the decision and text; continue with read_case_law_decision. Ambiguous gives candidates; incomplete_identifier gives missing parts. Country_unavailable: no identity surface. Missing stella:read requires OAuth consent.
name: resolve_case_law_decision
title: Resolve a case-law citation

description: Read a document's content, found anywhere in your accessible matters. DOCX files are converted to Markdown with structure preserved (headings, tables, lists); other formats return their extracted plain text. Use after search_across_matters. Long documents are returned in windows; pass the returned nextCursor back as cursor to read more.
name: read_content_across_matters
title: Read content across matters

description: List the documents and folders in a matter. Use 'flat' mode to enumerate every document and folder in the matter, or 'children' mode to walk the folder tree one level at a time (pass parent_id to list a folder's direct children, or omit it for the matter root). Returns each entity's id, name, kind (document or folder), and parentId. Read a document's metadata, fields, or versions with read_document.
name: list_documents
title: List documents

description: Read a document's metadata and field values by entity ID. By default returns the current version's name, kind, and field/property values. The default response also reports contentState and searchIndexState, including an actionable remediation or escalation requirement when document text processing is required. Pass version_id to inspect a specific version instead. Pass version_id and compare_with_version_id to get a plain-text line diff between two versions. Pass include_versions to also return the version history. To read the document's extracted text content, use read_content_across_matters.
name: read_document
title: Read document

description: Create a document or folder, or update an existing one. Omit entity_id to create: pass matter_id and name, optionally a parent_id folder and kind ('document' by default, or 'folder'). Creating makes an empty named entity; uploading file content is a separate step. Pass entity_id to update: set name to rename; parent_id to move it into a folder or move_to_root to move it to the matter root; version_id with label and/or description to annotate a version. An update needs at least one change. Returns the entity ID.
name: save_document
title: Save document

description: Create a tracked-changes DOCX redline. source 'versions' compares a stored base with up to 8 targets; 'previous' uses its predecessor; 'uploads' compares two .docx files from open_file_comparison, prepare_file_comparison_from_links or prepare_file_comparison. *_tracked_changes controls existing changes; 'accept' compares final text. output_mode 'preview' does not write, 'download' returns an expiring link, and 'version' saves a derived version from a stored source. Show every openUrl or download link.
name: compare_documents
title: Compare document versions

description: Reserve upload slots for redlining two .docx files that are not stored in stella, for a client that can PUT the bytes itself (the CLI, a script). In a chat, open_file_comparison provides a picker panel that uploads from the user's browser; prepare_file_comparison_from_links accepts files reachable by HTTPS link. Both files must be .docx and at most 50 MB. PUT each file's bytes to its url with the returned headers sent verbatim: the URL is signed against that exact size and checksum. Then call compare_documents with the echoed next.source, within the hour. The staged files and the redline are temporary and never become a document, a version, or matter content.
name: prepare_file_comparison
title: Prepare file comparison

description: Stage two .docx files for redlining from HTTPS links the server can download, so no bytes pass through the client. Each file is at most 50 MB and must be a .docx. Then call compare_documents with the echoed next.source, within the hour. The staged files and the redline are temporary and never become a document, a version, or matter content.
name: prepare_file_comparison_from_links
title: Prepare file comparison from links

description: Delete a document and all its versions, or delete a single version when version_id is provided (the current version is promoted to the next latest; the only remaining version cannot be deleted). This is irreversible.
name: delete_document
title: Delete document

description: List the property (column) definitions of a matter. Returns each property's id, name, value type (text, single-select, multi-select, date, int, or file), status, and writeMethod. Use set_field_value for scalar properties. Arbitrary file-property cells are not writable; document upload/version tools replace only a document's primary file.
name: list_properties
title: List properties

description: Set a document property cell. Pass entity_id, property_id from list_properties, and content matching the property's type: 'text' string; 'single-select' string or null; 'multi-select' string array; 'date' ISO value or null; or 'int' with optional 3-letter currency. An empty value clears the cell.
name: set_field_value
title: Set field value

description: Read a contact by ID. Use this after matter overview or entity metadata surfaces a contact the user wants to inspect more closely.
name: read_contact
title: Read contact

description: List or search the organization's internal contact directory. Returns internal contact IDs accepted by read_contact, save_contact, and link_matter_contact. Use q to search display names and type to filter people or organizations.
name: list_contacts
title: List contacts

description: Save a contact in the organization address book. Set contact_id to update; otherwise type and display_name or name parts create it. Null clears strings except display_name.
name: save_contact
title: Save contact

description: Permanently delete a contact from the organization address book. Rejected while the contact is still the client of any matter. This is irreversible.
name: delete_contact
title: Delete contact

description: Look up a company in a public business register. Pass a canonical identifier (company/registration number, VAT number) for an exact match, or a company name to search where supported; KRS matches are verified. Result IDs belong to the external registry, not stella's contact directory. Create a contact with save_contact before using read_contact.
name: lookup_business_registry
title: Look up business registry

description: Screen a company or person; `check` selects the source. Register outcomes are clear, found, not-registered (not a clearance), unavailable (not cleared), or not-covered. Sanctions returns each list's firm applicability and outcome: clear, possible-match requiring human review, incomplete (not cleared), or unavailable (not cleared). Only fully screened clear lists produce top-level clear. Verify person matches against name and birth date.
name: check_counterparty
title: Check counterparty

description: Set the practice jurisdictions for the user's stella organization. Call this when the org's practice jurisdictions are empty (e.g., the user signed up via an OAuth client and skipped onboarding). Pass an array of {country_code, is_primary}; exactly one entry should be primary.
name: set_practice_jurisdictions
title: Set practice jurisdictions

description: Update supplied non-secret settings. Pair matter_number_pattern with matter_number_padding. Provider secrets: dashboard; jurisdictions: set_practice_jurisdictions.
name: update_organization_settings
title: Update organization settings

description: Search the stella legislation corpus within one country: consolidated statutes, each with its ELI, title, language, document type, publication status, effective date and a matched snippet. Filters: document type, status, language, and an effective-date range (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). `as_of` searches text in force on that date; omit it to include historical wording. No facets are returned and `total` is not counted, so page with the returned nextCursor instead of reasoning about a result count. A hit is metadata only: pass its `eli` to read_statute for the text, the outline of anchors and the consolidated versions. Use `url` for the stella reader when served, otherwise the publisher; `source_url` is the publisher source.
name: search_legislation
title: Search legislation

description: Read one statute by ELI as it stood on a date: `as_of` picks the consolidation in force that day, and omitting it reads the text in force today. Returns that consolidation's metadata and validity window, `pendingChanges` (publisher-stated future or undated effects), `versions` (the newest page of the work's consolidations, with `amendedBy` effects), `outline` (its heading anchors, the input read_statute_provisions takes) on page 1, plus its plain text. Later pages omit outline and versions; pass the returned nextCursor back as cursor to read more. A source that bars AI use of its wording still answers with metadata, versions and outline, and `textWithheldReason` in place of the text. Use `url` for the stella reader when served, otherwise the publisher; `source_url` is the publisher source.
name: read_statute
title: Read statute

description: Read statute provisions: items[] entries are { eli, anchor } with optional as_of and language, or document_id from read_provision_history for an exact consolidation. document_id and as_of are mutually exclusive. Use publisher anchors from read_statute's outline (par_1729, par_1729-odst_1). Entries return in input order: found carries text; invalid, not_found, uncovered_date (no applicable consolidation, including inconsistent publisher dates), provision_not_found and text_withheld (AI use barred) carry messages. Continue long text with nextTextCursor as text_cursor on the same entry until null. url opens the stella reader when served, otherwise the publisher; source_url is the publisher source.
name: read_statute_provisions
title: Read statute provisions

description: Read one provision's wording in each consolidation of the work, newest validity window first, so two wordings can be compared without downloading whole statutes. Takes the work's `eli` and an `anchor` from read_statute's outline. A consolidation that does not carry the anchor is left out of `items`. Pass the returned nextCursor back as cursor for older versions. Long wording returns nextTextCursor on its item; pass it back as text_cursor with the same eli, anchor, and version-page cursor until it is null. Use `url` for the stella reader when served, otherwise the publisher; `source_url` is the publisher source.
name: read_provision_history
title: Read provision history

description: Resolve one statute provision from a citation or structured gazette identity and section. Supported countries: CZE, SVK; unrecognized or unsupported countries return country_unavailable. Omit as_of for the current expression. Returns the legal resolve API envelope: resolved carries a provision, readerUrl, force dates, versionStatus and blocks; not_found names unknown_document or unknown_section; incomplete_identifier lists missing parts; ambiguous lists candidates without choosing. Open through readerUrl; supply missing parts and retry. For unknown_document use search_legislation; for unknown_section search then read_statute_provisions. Add missing stella:search (search) or stella:read (read) through OAuth consent before recovery calls.
name: resolve_law_citation
title: Resolve a statute provision

description: Search and read Spanish consolidated legislation from the BOE. Search hits return the publisher link as primary `url`. In search mode, pass query (free text) and/or filters (title, department_code, legal_range_code, matter_code, date_from/date_to as YYYYMMDD); at least one filter is required. In read mode, pass law_id (e.g. BOE-A-1889-4763) to return the law with its block structure; add full_text to include the consolidated text, block_id to return one text block, or relation_type to list related laws instead. Returns public statutory data.
name: search_boe_legislation
title: Search BOE legislation

description: List the document templates in this organization (NDAs, powers of attorney, leases), or describe one template's fillable fields. Omit template_id to list templates: each template's id, name, field count, tags, and usage guidance (whenToUse / whenNotToUse); use a template whose whenToUse matches the request and skip any whose whenNotToUse applies. Pass template_id to return that template's full field configuration, its named conditions and formula fields. The configuration is in the shape configure_template_fields accepts (see stella://reference/template-fields), and the response carries that call to make next. `arrays` marks {% for %} fields as arrays of objects, not dotted keys.
name: list_templates
title: List templates

description: Fill a template and return the rendered text; pass output_mode='docx' for base64 bytes. Call list_templates first, then pass its field paths in values. Registry, composite, formula, and AI fields resolve automatically. Unknown keys fail unless allow_unused_values is true. Missing required values always fail. Unfilled placeholders or failed AI drafts fail unless completion_mode is allow_partial. Errors name exact paths; never guess required values. Output includes completionStatus.
name: fill_template
title: Fill template

description: Fill a registered template and persist its DOCX in a matter. Use create_document (optionally with parent_id) or create_version with entity_id. Call list_templates for field paths; never guess required values. Missing required values always fail. Unfilled placeholders or failed AI drafts stop writes unless completion_mode is allow_partial. Returns document/version ids and fill diagnostics.
name: save_filled_template
title: Save filled template

description: Fill a registered template and persist its DOCX in a matter. Use create_document (optionally with parent_id) or create_version with entity_id. Call list_templates for field paths; never guess required values. Missing required values always fail. Unfilled placeholders or failed AI drafts stop writes unless completion_mode is allow_partial. Returns document/version ids and fill diagnostics.
name: save_filled_template
title: Save filled template

description: Create a template from a DOCX, or publish a new version of one. To create, pass a name and the document. To publish over an existing template, pass its template_id with the document; template_id with only a name renames it. Same-name templates are never merged: only template_id matches an existing one. For the document, pass file (preferred, up to 50 MB) or the original bytes as docx_base64 (max 196608 bytes decoded within the 524288-byte MCP request frame); never retype the file or strip parts out to fit. Read stella://reference/template-markers before authoring: markers are the docxtpl dialect of Jinja, and a value marker's filters ARE its field's configuration. Returns the template id, its fields, arrays, conditions, computed values and warnings; configure_template_fields writes those filters.
name: create_template
title: Create template

description: Configure an existing template's field owner, input control, options and validation. This rewrites its field markers and affected {% if %} or registry markers, then publishes the result. Pass template_id and entries for existing field paths; omitted properties keep their marker settings. Read stella://reference/template-fields first. Returns the full configuration and entries that could not be applied.
name: configure_template_fields
title: Configure template fields

description: Ask what current values decide without filling. Returns every AI condition with `path`, `label`, and either `state: "decided"`, its `value`, `decided_by` (`user`, `decision_model`, or `generative_model`), and `probability` for model answers; or `state: "undecided"` and `reason` (`failed` or `refusal`). The decision model uses the generative model when it cannot settle a question. Consumes AI usage. A boolean in `values` wins. Nothing is written.
name: preview_template_conditions
title: Preview template conditions

description: List tasks, or read one task in detail. Pass task_id for one task's fields, assignees, and linked entities. Otherwise pass matter_id to list one matter's tasks, or omit it to list tasks across every matter you can read; filter by status, due date (date_from/date_to, ISO YYYY-MM-DD), or assignee. Soonest due first, undated last. Each task names its matter (id, name, reference).
name: list_tasks
title: List tasks

description: Create or update a task and its assignees and links. Omit task_id to create (matter_id and name required). Pass task_id to update name, item_type, status, priority or due_date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD; null clears). Assign a matter member by ID or email (assignee), or unassign by remove_assignee_user_id. Link with link_entity_id; unlink with unlink_link_id. Returns the task ID.
name: save_task
title: Save task

description: Permanently delete a task from its matter, together with its links, assignees and audit-visible field values. Refused while the matter is archived. This is irreversible.
name: delete_task
title: Delete task

description: List the clause library for this organization, or read one clause in detail. Pass clause_id to get a clause's body, description, usage notes, variants, and version history; add version_id to read one version's body. Otherwise list clauses (newest first), optionally filtered by category_id or a text query, and set include_categories to also return the category tree. Returns each clause's id, title, category, language, and current version.
name: list_clauses
title: List clauses

description: Create or update a library clause. Omit clause_id to create (title and body required); include it to update. body contains ordered paragraphs. Use balanced {% ... %} tags; keep num(), ref(), clause() and ai(adapt=true) in the template body. Clear category_id, language, description, usage_notes or metadata with null. Set snapshot_version true to append a body version on update. Returns the clause id.
name: save_clause
title: Save clause

description: Permanently delete a clause and all its variants and versions from the organization's clause library. This is irreversible.
name: delete_clause
title: Delete clause

description: List the review playbooks in this organization, or read one in detail. Pass playbook_id to get a playbook's positions (the issues it reviews, their questions, tiered rules, and ideal language), scope, and description. Otherwise list playbooks (newest first). Returns each playbook's id, name, and description.
name: list_playbooks
title: List playbooks

description: Create a review playbook or change its positions. Omit playbook_id to create (name required); to update, pass it with expected_updated_at. positions is a patch: source_id replaces one position, while no source_id adds one. Invalid entries return in issues; valid entries are saved. The result is a draft for human approval and returns the id, updatedAt for the next update, and written sourceIds.
name: save_playbook
title: Save playbook

description: Run a review playbook over a matter's documents. Materializes the playbook's extraction and verdict columns onto the matter's table and starts the AI review; findings populate asynchronously. Pass matter_id and playbook_id. Returns the number of columns queued for review.
name: run_playbook
title: Run playbook

description: List the highlights and comments on one case-law decision or one statute version that the user can see: their own, and those colleagues shared. Each mark lists the passages it covers by block anchor and quote, oldest first.
name: list_reader_annotations
title: List reader annotations

description: Highlight or comment on a passage of a case-law decision or a statute version, as the user. Quote the words to mark, one passage per paragraph, with its anchor when the document text shows one; the mark appears in the user's reader. Private unless visibility is shared. Resending the same call returns the mark it already made.
name: create_reader_annotation
title: Create reader annotation

description: Change one of the user's highlights or comments: a comment's words, a highlight's colour or style, or who sees it. Only the user's own marks can be changed; a colleague's shared mark reads as not found.
name: update_reader_annotation
title: Update reader annotation

description: Permanently delete one of the user's highlights or comments, every passage of it. Only the user's own marks can be changed; a colleague's shared mark reads as not found.
name: delete_reader_annotation
title: Delete reader annotation

description: List time entries in a matter, or read one entry in detail. Pass time_entry_id to get a single entry. Otherwise pass matter_id to list the matter's entries, optionally filtered by entity_id (the item the time was logged against), user_id, a date-worked range (date_from/date_to, ISO YYYY-MM-DD), and status. Returns each entry's id, entity, user, date, minutes, rate (minor currency units), currency, narrative, and status. The response includes visibility: all_entries for billing reviewers, or own_entries when the caller can see only their own time; own_entries is not a matter total.
name: list_time_entries
title: List time entries

description: Create or update a time entry. Omit time_entry_id to create (matter_id, date_worked, timezone_id, duration_minutes, and narrative required; entity_id is optional context). Pass time_entry_id to update: set date_worked (with timezone_id), duration_minutes, narrative, invoice_narrative, billable, no_charge, entity_id (move the entry), task_code, and/or activity_code. The timekeeper's effective rate is resolved server-side. Durations are whole minutes. Returns the time entry ID.
name: save_time_entry
title: Save time entry

description: Delete a time entry. A draft entry is permanently deleted; an approved entry is written off instead (kept for the audit trail, excluded from billing). A billed entry cannot be deleted until its invoice is reverted. Returns whether the entry was hard-deleted.
name: delete_time_entry
title: Delete time entry

description: Resolve an effective hourly rate from the matter's default table for the date: user+activity > role+activity > activity > user > role > table default. Returns integer minor-unit rate and currency, or nulls if none applies.
name: resolve_rate
title: Resolve billing rate

description: List invoices in a matter or read one. Pass invoice_id for one invoice: lines with their recorded source values, totals with the VAT breakdown, taxable supply date, seller profile id, buyer, and attached time entries and expenses; a client invoice needs access to every matter it bills. Otherwise pass matter_id to list. Returns id, number (null before numbering), document type, original invoice id, reference, status, dates, currency and total (integer minor units).
name: list_invoices
title: List invoices

description: Read the organization's current usage entitlement: plan, seats, billing period, and how many usage units (AI credits) remain this period. Returns { entitlement: null } when the organization has no active plan. Requires organization-settings management access.
name: get_usage
title: Get usage

description: Read the organization's audit trail (compliance view). Returns audit entries newest first, each with its action, resource type and id, actor user id, matter, timestamp, and change detail (null unless changesStatus is "visible"). Filter by matter_id, action, resource_type (with optional resource_id), user_id, and a created-at range (from/to, ISO date-time). Paginate with limit and cursor. Requires organization audit-log access.
name: list_audit_log
title: List audit log

description: Draft a bug, idea, missing-capability or docs report for the stella maintainers and get it back sanitized. Sends nothing: emails, UUIDs and ULIDs, secret-looking tokens, non-allowlisted URLs and IP addresses are redacted server-side, and the result is the report for you to show the human verbatim. Once they approve it, call submit_feedback with that same report, its approval_token and confirm: true. Describe the problem, then what you expected against what happened, then the steps. Refer to people by role, never by name. Never paste document text, matter or client names, or ids. Put the requestId of a failed call in context.request_id. The reporter's identity is stored privately and is never published.
name: prepare_feedback
title: Prepare feedback

description: File the report prepared by prepare_feedback with the stella maintainers. This sends the content out of the workspace: it is stored, emailed to the maintainers, and may be posted as a public issue, so it is refused without confirm: true and the report's approval_token. emails, UUIDs and ULIDs, secret-looking tokens, non-allowlisted URLs and IP addresses are redacted server-side again here, and the reporter's identity is stored privately and never published. Returns a receipt to give the human. Re-sending identical content within a day returns the original receipt and sends nothing.
name: submit_feedback
title: Submit feedback

description: List the automatable capabilities beyond the curated tools: every safe backend operation (CRUD, exports, processing triggers) reachable through read_capability or write_capability. Paginated; filter by domain (the id prefix, e.g. "time-entries") or access (read/write), or search ids, titles, and descriptions with query. Each item gives the capability id, description, access/destructive, its transport (whether this path can run it, which field takes a file, and what to use instead), handlerKind (workspace or root), and every OAuth scope it needs. Use describe_capability for the full input schema.
name: list_capabilities
title: List capabilities

description: Describe one capability in full: its live input JSON Schema (body/params/query), required OAuth scopes, member permissions, whether it is destructive, its handler kind (workspace/root), its disposition, and its transport (whether this path can run it, which field takes a file, and what to use instead). Call this before read_capability or write_capability to learn exactly what input to pass.
name: describe_capability
title: Describe capability

description: Read one capability by id. Take a read id from list_capabilities or describe_capability. Pass input under input: { body, params, query }; matter-scoped capabilities take input.params.matterId. Required scopes and member permissions are checked per capability. Set validate_only: true to check input without running it. Write capabilities must use write_capability.
name: read_capability
title: Read capability

description: Write one capability by id. Take a write id from list_capabilities or describe_capability. Pass input under input: { body, params, query }; matter-scoped capabilities take input.params.matterId. Required scopes and member permissions are checked per capability. Set validate_only: true to check input without running it; Capabilities declaring confirmation require confirm: true after human approval. Read capabilities must use read_capability.
name: write_capability
title: Write capability

description: Request an asynchronous export of your own personal data across current organization memberships. Organization and matter content are excluded. One active export is reused. Poll account-exports.status.get with the returned id as exportId, then call account-exports.download.get when ready. Pass nextCall to read_capability. Downloads require your authenticated account and expire after one hour.
name: capability:account-exports.create
title: account-exports.create

description: Get an expiring authenticated download URL for your ready personal data export. Returns downloadUrl and expiresAt, never archive bytes. Open the URL in a browser signed in to the same account, or fetch it with an OAuth token that has stella:account_export_read consent. Poll account-exports.status.get while building; call account-exports.create for an expired or failed export.
name: capability:account-exports.download.get
title: account-exports.download.get

description: Read your most recent personal data export as latest, which is null before your first request. Use account-exports.create to request an export, account-exports.status.get to poll its ID, and account-exports.download.get when it is ready.
name: capability:account-exports.get
title: account-exports.get

description: Read the status of your personal data export by its returned ID. Requested or processing exports are still building; poll again later. For ready exports call account-exports.download.get. For failed or expired exports call account-exports.create to request a replacement.
name: capability:account-exports.status.get
title: account-exports.status.get

description: Read the organization's audit trail (compliance view). Returns audit entries newest first, each with its action, resource type and id, actor user id, matter, timestamp, and change detail (null unless changesStatus is "visible"). Filter by matterId, action, resourceType (with optional resourceId), userId, and a created-at range (from/to, ISO date-time). Paginate with limit and cursor. Requires organization audit-log access.
name: capability:audit-logs.list
title: audit-logs.list

description: Add one task or activity billing code to a matter's code list. The code string must be unique within the matter for its type, so the same literal may exist once as a task code and once as an activity code; a duplicate of the same type is refused, and the matter has a fixed cap on how many codes it may hold.
name: capability:billing-codes.create
title: billing-codes.create

description: Permanently delete one billing code (a task or activity code) from a matter's code list. Time entries already recorded under it keep their stored code string, so past entries are not rewritten; the code just stops being offered. Remove activity rates referencing the code before deleting it.
name: capability:billing-codes.delete
title: billing-codes.delete

description: List a matter's task and activity billing codes, ordered by sort order then code, with cursor pagination. Filter by type (task or activity) and by whether the code is still active.
name: capability:billing-codes.list
title: billing-codes.list

description: Change one billing code's code string, label, sort order, or active flag in a matter. Only the fields you pass are written, the code string must stay unique within the matter for its type, and deactivating a code stops it being offered without rewriting entries already recorded under it.
name: capability:billing-codes.update
title: billing-codes.update

description: Read the structural analysis of one court decision, starting generation when there is none yet. The analysis is generated by stella, not by the court: show its aiDisclosure text to the user beside anything taken from it. Returns status done with the stored analysis and aiDisclosure, generating while a run is in flight (poll until it is done), or error with a code: decision_not_found, document_unparseable, language_unsupported, analysis_disabled or source_restricted when no analysis can be made; answer_incomplete, timed_out, provider_refused, provider_unavailable or failed when the last run failed, with key naming whose AI key it used (the organization's own, or the platform's). A failed run answers callers using the same key for 15 minutes; within that window a call passing retry=true starts a new run, and after it the next call starts one on its own. When the provider named a later time to retry, the failure carries it as retryAt (ISO 8601) and answers every call, retry=true included, until then. Generation runs in the background and a call made while one is already running does not start a second.
name: capability:case-law.analysis.generate
title: case-law.analysis.generate

description: Report case-law corpus ingestion health for operators. Per source: adapter key and whether an adapter is still registered for it, enabled flag, sync cursor, decisions held against the total the publisher reports, decisions inserted in the last hour and last day, failures and the top error types in the last day, the last ingestion event, and standing reconciliation counts (slices surveyed, short slices, parked and terminal items, pending removals and unprobeable identities). The fleet event total is an estimate from database statistics and may lag recent writes. Requires organization audit-log access.
name: capability:case-law.ingestion.get
title: case-law.ingestion.get

description: Link a selection of case-law decisions to the current matter in one call, each with an optional note. Best effort and idempotent: the response reports every decision asked for, under `linked` (newly pinned), `existing` (already pinned, returned unchanged with the note recorded earlier) or `rejected` with a reason — `not_found` for a decision that is not in the corpus, `limit` for one that would push the matter past its maximum number of links. A decision already pinned never counts against that maximum. The whole call is one transaction: either every link it reports lands, or none does. Repeat the call with the same items safely; the second call reports them as `existing`. At most as many items as the matter may hold links.
name: capability:case-law.matter-links.batch.create
title: case-law.matter-links.batch.create

description: Link one case-law decision from the corpus to the current matter, with an optional note. A decision that is not in the corpus is a 404; a decision already linked to this matter returns the existing link unchanged, note included, even when the matter is full, because re-linking adds nothing. The call is refused only when it would add a link past the matter's maximum. To link a selection at once, use the batch call instead of repeating this one.
name: capability:case-law.matter-links.create
title: case-law.matter-links.create

description: Unlink one case-law decision from a matter, deleting the link and the note recorded on it. The decision itself stays in the case-law corpus and can be linked again.
name: capability:case-law.matter-links.delete
title: case-law.matter-links.delete

description: List the case-law decisions linked to the current matter, newest link first, each with its note and the decision's row facts: case number, slug, ECLI, court, country, language, the decision's other language versions, date, type, citation count and headnote preview. Returns the whole set up to the per-matter link cap; there is no pagination. Withdrawn decisions return only a translated marker beside the saved note.
name: capability:case-law.matter-links.list
title: case-law.matter-links.list

description: Install one catalogue skill into the organization by slug, at team scope (the default) or private scope. Team scope requires admin or owner. The skill is stored as bundled content, so it cannot be edited afterwards. Refused when that slug is already installed at the same scope, or when the scope's skill limit is reached.
name: capability:catalogue.install
title: catalogue.install

description: List the tool catalogue for the signed-in user's organization: curated skills, MCP connectors, and native tools, plus the organization's own custom skills and custom MCP connectors as synthetic entries. Each entry reports its install state, whether it is enabled, whether it is locked (a baseline capability that cannot be toggled), whether it is recommended for the organization's practice jurisdictions, and the handles the uninstall paths need. The practice jurisdictions behind those recommendations are returned alongside.
name: capability:catalogue.list
title: catalogue.list

description: Find your own conversation about one case-law decision: the most recently active of your global chat threads whose subject is that decision, or null when you have none yet. A decision's chat is one conversation, so a reader reopening the decision continues it rather than starting another.
name: capability:chat.decision-threads.get
title: chat.decision-threads.get

description: Export one assistant chat message as a DOCX document with the selected citation style. Returns a short-lived download URL.
name: capability:chat.export.create
title: chat.export.create

description: Fork one of your own chat threads into a new thread that keeps the history up to a chosen answer, so another direction or model can be explored without touching the original. The boundary must be an assistant message: a fork branches off an answer, not off an ask. The new thread id is minted by the caller, which makes a retried fork return the existing copy instead of duplicating it. Attachments are duplicated, never shared: deleting either thread leaves the other's files intact. The fork records where it came from and starts with no compaction state of its own.
name: capability:chat.fork.create
title: chat.fork.create

description: Read the most recent page of one of your own chat threads, together with the thread's context matters, model and reasoning-effort settings, anonymization flag, whether web search is available and enabled, and an estimate of the model context the next send would carry. Pass matterId for a matter-scoped thread and omit it for a global one; a scope that contradicts the stored thread is rejected. With allowMissingThread, a thread that does not exist yet returns an empty draft instead of a 404. Page further back with chat.older-messages.list.
name: capability:chat.messages.list
title: chat.messages.list

description: Read retained versions of an assistant answer in your chat thread, newest first. Each item contains the replaced content, accepted edit, beforeText and afterText for that change, and actorName when the author is still an organization member. The current answer is returned by chat.messages.list. Use nextCursor to read earlier versions.
name: capability:chat.messages.revisions.list
title: chat.messages.revisions.list

description: Page backwards through one of your own chat threads using the olderCursor a previous read returned. Returns only the message page and the next cursor, without the thread settings and context estimate that chat.messages.list carries. The thread must be yours and the matterId scope must match the one it was created in.
name: capability:chat.older-messages.list
title: chat.older-messages.list

description: Permanently delete one of your own chat threads with its messages and the files uploaded to it; the stored file objects are deleted, not just dereferenced. Succeeds silently when the thread does not exist or belongs to someone else.
name: capability:chat.threads.delete
title: chat.threads.delete

description: List your own chat threads, most recently active first, split into global threads and groups per matter. Threads with no messages, and threads belonging to a matter that is being deleted, are left out. Each thread carries a bounded preview of its context: the matters and files it drew on, with their total counts, and the case-law decision the chat is about, if any. search matches the thread title, the matter it lives in, or a matter pinned to it; matterId keeps only the threads that live in that matter (not global threads that merely pinned it) and is not found when you cannot open the matter; paginate with limit and cursor.
name: capability:chat.threads.list
title: chat.threads.list

description: Set the title of one of your own chat threads. The new title is marked as user-chosen, so automatic title generation can never overwrite it afterwards. A thread that does not exist in the requested scope is a 404: this never creates one.
name: capability:chat.threads.rename
title: chat.threads.rename

description: Turn web search on or off for one of your own chat threads. Unlike chat.threads.rename this is an upsert: when no thread exists under that id it is created as an empty placeholder carrying the flag, so a draft can record the setting before its first message is sent.
name: capability:chat.threads.update
title: chat.threads.update

description: Create a category in the organization's clause library taxonomy, optionally under a parent category. Refused once the organization holds its maximum number of categories, or when the named parent does not exist.
name: capability:clauses.categories.create
title: clauses.categories.create

description: Delete one category from the organization's clause library taxonomy. No clause is deleted: clauses filed under the category become uncategorized, and its child categories are re-parented to its own parent.
name: capability:clauses.categories.delete
title: clauses.categories.delete

description: List the organization's clause categories in sort order, each with its id, parent, name, description, and sort order. The taxonomy is capped per organization and comes back whole; there is no pagination.
name: capability:clauses.categories.list
title: clauses.categories.list

description: Rename or re-describe one clause category, move it under a different parent (or to the root by passing null), or change its sort order. Only the fields you pass are written. A category cannot become its own parent, and a move that would make the tree circular is refused.
name: capability:clauses.categories.update
title: clauses.categories.update

description: Create a clause in the organization's clause library: a title and an ordered body of paragraphs, plus optional category, language, description, usage notes, and metadata. The clause starts at version 1 with a matching version snapshot. Refused when the organization is at its clause limit or the category does not exist.
name: capability:clauses.create
title: clauses.create

description: Permanently delete a clause and all its variants and versions from the organization's clause library. This is irreversible.
name: capability:clauses.delete
title: clauses.delete

description: Read one clause in full: its body, category, language, description, usage notes, metadata, and current version number, plus every variant in sort order and the list of its stored versions. Use clauses.versions.get for the body of a particular version.
name: capability:clauses.get
title: clauses.get

description: List the organization's clause library. Without q, clauses come back newest first with cursor pagination; with q they are matched on the title as a substring or on the clause text as a prefix search, ordered by title, and no cursor is returned. Filter by categoryId. Items carry title, category, language, description, and current version but not the body: read that with clauses.get.
name: capability:clauses.list
title: clauses.list

description: Rewrite the prose of a clause body with the model, following a free-text instruction plus the clause title and usage notes when supplied. The body goes in and the revised body comes back, so this works on an unsaved draft as well; nothing is stored. The model is instructed to keep paragraph order, lists, and every {{ }} template marker, and to change ordinary paragraph text only, but the result is not verified against the original, so review a rewrite before saving one that carries markers. A changed paragraph loses its inline formatting. Consumes AI usage.
name: capability:clauses.rewrite
title: clauses.rewrite

description: Resolve one template's clause slots to the plain text of the clauses linked to them, keyed by slot name, using the same version and variant rules the fill path applies, so the preview matches the filled document. Slots that are unlinked, or whose target version cannot be resolved, are left out and keep their marker visible.
name: capability:clauses.template-slots.preview
title: clauses.template-slots.preview

description: Change a clause's title, category, language, body, description, usage notes, or metadata; only the fields you pass are written. By default a new body is saved as the working copy without touching history. Pass snapshotVersion true to also append a version snapshot and move the current version forward: that is skipped when the body is identical to the latest snapshot, and refused when the clause is at its version limit. Pass expectedBody from your last read to require the working copy still matches; a changed body returns a conflict without writing.
name: capability:clauses.update
title: clauses.update

description: Add a variant, an alternative wording of a clause carrying its own label, to one clause. Refused when the clause does not exist in this organization or already holds its maximum number of variants.
name: capability:clauses.variants.create
title: clauses.variants.create

description: Permanently delete one variant (an alternative wording) of a clause, leaving the clause and its other variants in place. Templates that used the variant fall back to the clause itself and keep only a stale label snapshot of what was removed.
name: capability:clauses.variants.delete
title: clauses.variants.delete

description: List one clause's variants in sort order, each with its label, body, and position. A clause that does not belong to this organization is a 404.
name: capability:clauses.variants.list
title: clauses.variants.list

description: Change one variant's label, body, or position within its clause; only the fields you pass are written.
name: capability:clauses.variants.update
title: clauses.variants.update

description: Return a plain-text, line-level diff between one stored clause version and the clause's current body. An empty segment list means the two are identical. This is what backs the what-changed disclosure shown on a template link pointing at an outdated version.
name: capability:clauses.versions.diff
title: clauses.versions.diff

description: Read the stored body of one specific clause version, with its version number and creation time. Use clauses.get for the clause's current body and its version list, and clauses.versions.restore to bring an old version back into use.
name: capability:clauses.versions.get
title: clauses.versions.get

description: Restore a stored clause version by copying its body onto the clause as a new version. History is append-only: the older versions stay and the version number moves forward rather than back. The body is read server-side from the version id, never supplied by the caller. Refused when the clause is at its version limit. Optionally pass expectedBody from your last read to require the head still matches before restoring.
name: capability:clauses.versions.restore
title: clauses.versions.restore

description: Summarize in prose what changed between one stored clause version and the clause's current body, over the same diff clauses.versions.diff returns. Returns summary null when the two are identical, skipping the model call. Consumes AI usage.
name: capability:clauses.versions.summarize
title: clauses.versions.summarize

description: Create one client draft from approved unbilled hourly work across selected matters. Every matter must belong to the client and be accessible. No partial invoice is returned. At most 1000 lines across 50 matters. Select the returned workspaceId as the matterId for invoices.get, finalize and PDF export. For line edits, use that line's workspaceId from invoices.get. Line overrides edit the invoice only, through invoices.lines.update.
name: capability:client-invoices.create
title: client-invoices.create

description: Prepare grouped unbilled work for a client's accessible matters. Optional inclusive periodStart and periodEnd select work dates. At most 50 matters and 500 items per matter. Pass selected matter and entry IDs to client-invoices.create; no draft is saved by this read.
name: capability:client-invoices.prefill
title: client-invoices.prefill

description: Screen a company or person against an official source, such as the Czech insolvency or VAT register, or against every sanctions list. A register check returns one outcome: clear (the source answered and holds nothing adverse), found (with the adverse records), not-registered (the source holds no record of the subject), unavailable (the source could not answer; never read this as clear), or not-covered (the source cannot answer for this subject type). The sanctions check returns one outcome per list (clear, possible-match, incomplete or unavailable) with the edition screened, and is clear only when every list was fully screened and clear. Incomplete means only a bounded subset of the list was screened and nothing matched; it is not a clearance.
name: capability:contacts.business-registries.check
title: contacts.business-registries.check

description: Look up a company in a public business register. Pass a canonical identifier (company/registration number, VAT number) for an exact match, or a company name to search where the register supports it.
name: capability:contacts.business-registries.lookup
title: contacts.business-registries.lookup

description: Create an organization address-book contact. Supply id, type (person or organization) and displayName; other fields are optional. Refuses the contact limit, attorney IDs outside this organization, and an external source/id already used by another contact.
name: capability:contacts.create
title: contacts.create

description: Permanently delete a contact from the organization address book. Rejected while the contact is still the client of any matter. This is irreversible.
name: capability:contacts.delete
title: contacts.delete

description: Read a contact by ID.
name: capability:contacts.get
title: contacts.get

description: Import a reviewed batch of up to 500 contacts into the organization address book. Supply a caller-generated importRequestId: replaying it with the same rows returns the original result, while changing the rows is rejected. taxIdScheme selects tax-id validation (none, or br_cpf_cnpj checksums with duplicate detection). A row may carry external (source and id in the system it came from): a later import of the same ref updates a changed contact or reports it unchanged. Rows failing the import rules, duplicates, and over-limit rows are skipped; all accepted rows commit atomically.
name: capability:contacts.import
title: contacts.import

description: List the organization address book alphabetically by display name, with cursor pagination. Filter by type (person or organization) and by q, which matches a substring of the display name only. Each item carries the names, emails, phones, tags, and the number of matters the contact is the client of. Use contacts.search for a short unpaginated lookup that also matches first, last, and organization names.
name: capability:contacts.list
title: contacts.list

description: Read durable new and reopened sanctions events in bounded cursor pages. Changed evidence and review decisions do not notify. Excluded contacts and disabled firms are omitted. This feed does not deliver notifications or select recipients.
name: capability:contacts.sanctions.events.list
title: contacts.sanctions.events.list

description: Read a contact's sanctions coverage per list and a bounded cursor page of current matches. Follow matches.nextCursor until null; matches.items contains evidence, review disposition and reviewTarget. Unavailable never means clear. Binding versus informational uses the firm's practice jurisdictions. To review a current match, call contacts.sanctions.reviews.update with its reviewTarget, a dismissed or confirmed disposition and a reason.
name: capability:contacts.sanctions.get
title: contacts.sanctions.get

description: List open sanctions matches for the active organization in bounded cursor pages with binding versus informational classification from the firm's practice jurisdictions. Only fresh, currently screened contacts included in monitoring are returned. Dismissed and confirmed matches are omitted. To review a match, read contacts.sanctions.get with the returned contactId and copy its reviewTarget to contacts.sanctions.reviews.update with a disposition and reason.
name: capability:contacts.sanctions.matches.list
title: contacts.sanctions.matches.list

description: Set a contact to included or excluded from sanctions monitoring. Excluding hides active hits and preserves history. Including queues a re-screen; read contacts.sanctions.get for its eventual result. Firm-level disablement still applies. Changes are audited.
name: capability:contacts.sanctions.monitoring.update
title: contacts.sanctions.monitoring.update

description: Dismiss or confirm one current sanctions match with a reason. Read contacts.sanctions.get first and copy the match's reviewTarget, then supply disposition and reason. A stale reviewTarget is rejected; read the contact again before retrying. A decision remains valid only while the contact fingerprint and listed-entry hash remain unchanged. Repeating the same decision is idempotent; changed evidence reopens it.
name: capability:contacts.sanctions.reviews.update
title: contacts.sanctions.reviews.update

description: Look up contacts by name, for a picker: q matches a substring of the display name, first name, last name, or organization name, normalized so Arabic spellings match, optionally narrowed by type. Returns at most 20 contacts ordered by display name with no cursor; use contacts.list to page the whole address book.
name: capability:contacts.search
title: contacts.search

description: Change a contact in the organization address book, writing only the fields you pass and clearing a nullable one when you pass null. metadata is merged into the stored object rather than replacing it. An attorney id that is not a member of the organization is refused, and an unknown contact is a 404.
name: capability:contacts.update
title: contacts.update

description: Inspect the current DOCX version and prepare its comment requirements for translation.
name: capability:document-translations.prepare
title: document-translations.prepare

description: Start a background document translation and save only the completed output as a new document.
name: capability:document-translations.runs.create
title: document-translations.runs.create

description: Read a document translation run and its progress.
name: capability:document-translations.runs.get
title: document-translations.runs.get

description: Add one document type to the organization's classification list. Its key is slugified from the label and de-duplicated automatically, and the type is appended at the end of the display order. Refused once the organization holds the maximum number of document types.
name: capability:document-types.create
title: document-types.create

description: Remove one document type from the organization's classification list so it can no longer be assigned. Documents already classified as that type keep their stored label; the call is refused while any playbook is scoped to the type.
name: capability:document-types.delete
title: document-types.delete

description: List the organization's document types in display order, each with its id, immutable key, label, and sort order. The starter taxonomy is seeded when the organization is created, so this only ever reads. The list is bounded and returned whole rather than paginated.
name: capability:document-types.list
title: document-types.list

description: Set the display order of the organization's document types: each id's position in orderedIds becomes its sort order. Ids that do not belong to the organization are ignored, and any type you leave out of the list keeps the sort order it already had. Ordering is cosmetic, so no audit event is recorded.
name: capability:document-types.reorder
title: document-types.reorder

description: Rename one document type. Only the label changes: the key is immutable, and the display order is set through document-types.reorder.
name: capability:document-types.update
title: document-types.update

description: Create tracked-changes DOCX redlines between stored versions of one document in a matter. Select an explicit base and up to 8 targets, or compare one target with its immediate predecessor. Strict mode refuses an unverified redline; best-effort returns it with explicit verification failures. Output preview compares without writing; output download writes each redline to temporary storage and returns an expiring link without saving it to the document; output version explicitly saves each successful redline as a derived document version without replacing the current version. The operation may partially succeed across multiple targets, so inspect every result status. Saving the same comparison inputs again returns the same derived version; retrying a lost response does not create a duplicate. Folio-exact review preserves both document endpoints; compatibility reports when pending history requires Folio and may be discarded by Word on save. Created results include an openUrl and a temporary DOCX download URL; downloadable results carry the temporary link alone. Show these links to the user; if download delivery is unavailable, the redline is already saved: open it in stella instead of creating it again.
name: capability:documents.compare
title: documents.compare

description: List the redline suggestions queued on one document, oldest first: each suggestion's id, its document operation, comment, severity, area, status (pending, accepted, rejected) and origin (chat or review). Filter by status to find what still awaits a decision; pass a suggestion id to docx-suggestions.resolve or docx-suggestions.revert.
name: capability:docx-suggestions.list
title: docx-suggestions.list

description: Record a decision on one pending redline suggestion: accepted (with the mode the change was applied in) or rejected. This records the decision only and does not edit the document file, so accept a suggestion only once its change is in the document. A suggestion that is no longer pending answers { updated: false } and is left as it is; a linked document-review finding takes the same decision.
name: capability:docx-suggestions.resolve
title: docx-suggestions.resolve

description: Return an accepted or rejected redline suggestion to pending, clearing who resolved it and when. This does not undo a change already applied to the document file. A suggestion that is already pending answers { updated: false }; a document at its pending-suggestion limit refuses the revert. A linked document-review finding is reopened with it.
name: capability:docx-suggestions.revert
title: docx-suggestions.revert

description: Create a two-column bilingual copy of a DOCX document (source text on the left, a copy to translate on the right) as a new document.
name: capability:entities.bilingual.create
title: entities.bilingual.create

description: Create a document in a matter whose file is a fresh empty DOCX built from the stella template, optionally inside a parent folder. Returns the entity, its file field, and the file name, so it can be opened in the editor straight away. Use entities.create for a document with no file at all.
name: capability:entities.blank-document.create
title: entities.blank-document.create

description: Save an external source as a link entity in the current matter: a title and url, plus optional snippet, citation, jurisdiction, and source type. No file is stored, only the reference and its metadata. Refused once the matter holds its maximum number of entities.
name: capability:entities.clip
title: entities.clip

description: Copy a document or folder subtree into another matter, or move it with deleteSource, which permanently deletes the source documents and their no-longer-referenced files. A copy starts a new version history; a move carries the existing one across, so every printed reference keeps resolving. Fields whose property has no counterpart in the target matter are dropped rather than remapped, so a move can lose column values; read-only entities are refused.
name: capability:entities.copy
title: entities.copy

description: Create an empty document, folder, or task in a matter (kind defaults to document) with a name and an optional parent folder. Nothing is attached: use entities.upload or the uploads flow to bring in a file, and entities.blank-document.create for a document that starts from an empty DOCX. Refused when the matter is at its entity limit or the parent is not a usable folder in this matter.
name: capability:entities.create
title: entities.create

description: Permanently delete documents, folders, or tasks from one matter, together with their versions, field values, and stored files. Refused while any of them is read-only or has a document-processing run in flight; unlike entities.versions.delete this is a real delete, not a tombstone.
name: capability:entities.delete
title: entities.delete

description: Copy one document, or a folder with its whole subtree, inside the same matter, placing the copy alongside the original. Stored files are copied too, so the copies own their own bytes and get their own text extraction and PDF and thumbnail derivatives. Use entities.copy to copy into a different matter.
name: capability:entities.duplicate
title: entities.duplicate

description: List every document in a matter that has an uploaded file, oldest first with cursor pagination, each with its entity id, name, parent folder, file field id, file name, and media type. Documents without a file, and folders and tasks, are left out; use entities.list for the full table with column values.
name: capability:entities.files.list
title: entities.files.list

description: Read a cursor page of a matter's folders and documents, using the same filters, sorts, and search as the table listings; tasks are excluded. When a filter or search hides intermediate folders, their parent links come back separately as ancestorLinks, so a matched row's full path can still be resolved without those folders entering the tree itself.
name: capability:entities.filesystem-tree.get
title: entities.filesystem-tree.get

description: Create a folder and move the given documents, folders, or tasks into it in one step. The folder is created under parentId, or at the matter root when parentId is null; a name already used there gets a numbered suffix. Refused as a whole, creating nothing, when the matter is at its entity limit, the parent is not a folder in this matter, an entity is not found or is read-only, or a folder would move into itself or one of its own descendants.
name: capability:entities.folder-from-selection.create
title: entities.folder-from-selection.create

description: List the folders of a matter, oldest first with cursor pagination, each with its id, name, and parent folder. Documents and tasks are left out; use entities.filesystem-tree.get for the folder tree with the documents in it.
name: capability:entities.folders.list
title: entities.folders.list

description: Compile a plain-text legal draft written in stella's legal-source markup into a DOCX and store it as a new document in the current matter. Returns the new entity and its file field plus a ready-made link and mention for chat. Refused with a structural-repair error when the source cannot be compiled, and when the generated file exceeds the document size limit or the matter is at its entity limit.
name: capability:entities.from-legal-source.create
title: entities.from-legal-source.create

description: Read one document, folder, or task in a matter: its kind, name, current version id, creation time and document reference, that version's field values, and which field is the current text-extraction source. Use entities.versions.get to read a historical version, and entities.versions.list for the version list.
name: capability:entities.get
title: entities.get

description: List a matter's documents, folders, and tasks as table rows with cursor pagination and view filters, sorts, and search. Returns file metadata by default; use visible fieldMode and fieldIds to select columns. Text previews are capped at 512 characters and marked truncated. Use entities.get for complete values. excludedKinds drops kinds and previewableForAi keeps documents whose content a model can read. Use entities.filesystem-tree.get for folder pages.
name: capability:entities.list
title: entities.list

description: Move one document, folder, or task into another folder of the same matter, or out to the matter root by passing parentId null. The target must be a folder in this matter, a folder may not be moved into itself or into one of its own descendants, and a read-only entity is refused.
name: capability:entities.move
title: entities.move

description: Queue an unencrypted PDF field for the next searchable-text recognition batch. Returns the durable run and the OCR availability it was accepted under (`live` or `batched`), and reports when that source was already processed. Refused when the deployment would not process it.
name: capability:entities.ocr.create
title: entities.ocr.create

description: Propose a folder placement and a tidied file name for up to 100 documents of a matter, given the folders that already exist plus an optional locale and free-text instructions. Returns one suggestion per file (folder path, suggested name, detected date, document type) and the empty folders it suggests removing. Suggestions only: nothing is moved, renamed, or deleted, so apply what you want with entities.move and entities.rename. Per-document summaries are generated and cached where missing, and the call consumes AI usage.
name: capability:entities.placements.suggest
title: entities.placements.suggest

description: Rename one document, folder, or task in a matter. For a document the stored file name is renamed to match, so the table's file column stays in step with the entity name. A read-only entity is refused.
name: capability:entities.rename
title: entities.rename

description: Count all documents, folders, and tasks in a matter. The companion total for entities.summaries.list, whose pages carry no count of their own.
name: capability:entities.summaries.count
title: entities.summaries.count

description: List a matter's documents, folders, and tasks as bare id and name pairs, newest first with cursor pagination. The cheapest listing available: no column values, no file metadata, no filters. Use entities.summaries.count for the total and entities.list when you need column values or filtering.
name: capability:entities.summaries.list
title: entities.summaries.list

description: Tombstone one version of a document: it disappears from listings, downloads, and restores, but the row and its stored file are retained for chain of custody. Deleting the current version promotes the next surviving one; the last remaining version, a read-only document, and a version still being processed are refused.
name: capability:entities.versions.delete
title: entities.versions.delete

description: Set or clear the free-text description on one version of a document, up to 1024 characters. An annotation only: no file and no field value changes. A version tombstoned by entities.versions.delete is refused. Use entities.versions.label.update for the short label instead.
name: capability:entities.versions.description.update
title: entities.versions.description.update

description: Return a plain-text, line-level diff of one document version's DOCX against its immediate predecessor; the first version is diffed against an empty document. Both texts are resolved server-side from the ids, and an empty segment list means nothing changed. Use documents.compare for a DOCX redline between versions you choose.
name: capability:entities.versions.diff
title: entities.versions.diff

description: Read one specific version of a document in a matter: its version number, stamp, creation time, and the field values stored on that version. A version tombstoned by entities.versions.delete reads as not found. Use entities.get for the current version.
name: capability:entities.versions.get
title: entities.versions.get

description: Set or clear the short label on one version of a document, up to 128 characters, for marking a version as a draft, an execution copy, and so on. An annotation only, like entities.versions.description.update, which carries the longer note. A tombstoned version is refused.
name: capability:entities.versions.label.update
title: entities.versions.label.update

description: List one document's version history, newest first, with a before cursor for older pages. Each version carries its number, stamp, label, description, the words added and removed against its predecessor, its author, the file attached to it, and, for a file imported from another system, its importOrigin (source, id, original dates and author); tombstoned versions are left out. The response also names the entity's current version.
name: capability:entities.versions.list
title: entities.versions.list

description: Restore a historical document version by copying it into a new current version; the prior history remains intact.
name: capability:entities.versions.restore
title: entities.versions.restore

description: Summarize in prose what changed between one document version and its predecessor, over the same server-resolved text diff entities.versions.diff returns. Returns summary null for identical versions, skipping the model call entirely. Consumes AI usage.
name: capability:entities.versions.summarize
title: entities.versions.summarize

description: Read a window of a matter's documents, folders, and tasks with the same filters, sorts, search, and field selection as entities.list, plus the find filter, but with the page bounds the virtualized table scrolls by (200 rows by default). Prefer entities.list unless you are filling a table viewport.
name: capability:entities.window.list
title: entities.window.list

description: Save a personal Table or Kanban view across accessible matters. Layout filters and sorts use the same contract as matter views.
name: capability:entity-views.create
title: entity-views.create

description: Delete one personal cross-matter view. This does not delete its records or proposals.
name: capability:entity-views.delete
title: entity-views.delete

description: List the current user's saved cross-matter views in tab order. The complete list is bounded by the per-user creation limit.
name: capability:entity-views.list
title: entity-views.list

description: Reorder every personal cross-matter view. Supply each of the user's view IDs exactly once.
name: capability:entity-views.reorder
title: entity-views.reorder

description: Read a table or Kanban window across accessible matters, with the same filters, sorts, fields and cursors as a matter view. With `inboxView`, the window also holds the caller's Inbox signals for that view, ordered by the same sorts under one cursor, and limits tasks to the view's lifecycle slice. Task rows carry their governed-work risk as of `asOf`.
name: capability:entity-views.rows.list
title: entity-views.rows.list

description: Change the name or layout of one personal cross-matter view. Other users' views cannot be changed.
name: capability:entity-views.update
title: entity-views.update

description: Record a disbursement in the current matter against a work item (matterId: the document, folder, or task the cost belongs to). amount is an integer in minor currency units with a 3-letter currency; dateIncurred is read in the timezoneId you pass and is refused when it is in the future or older than the entry-age limit. The expense starts as a draft.
name: capability:expenses.create
title: expenses.create

description: Delete an expense: a draft expense is permanently deleted, and any other unbilled expense is written off instead (kept for the audit trail, excluded from billing). A billed expense is refused until its invoice is reverted; the return value says which of the two happened.
name: capability:expenses.delete
title: expenses.delete

description: List expenses in a matter, earliest date first, with cursor pagination. Filter by userId, work item (matterId), a date-incurred range (dateFrom/dateTo, ISO YYYY-MM-DD), status, category, and billable. Each item carries the amount in minor currency units, currency, category, markup percentage, status, and the recording user's name.
name: capability:expenses.list
title: expenses.list

description: Change a draft or approved expense in a matter: its date, amount, currency, category, description, invoice description, billable flag, markup, work item, or status (draft or approved). A billed or written-off expense is refused; use expenses.delete to write off an unbilled one.
name: capability:expenses.update
title: expenses.update

description: Set the manual flags and lock state of one cell, meaning one document's value for one property. manualFlags is merged against baseManualFlags rather than overwritten, so flags added or removed by someone else since you read the cell survive; when no flags remain and the cell is not locked, the metadata row is deleted. Use fields.upsert to change the cell's value itself, and fields.column-flag.update to flag a whole column at once.
name: capability:fields.cell-metadata.update
title: fields.cell-metadata.update

description: Set or clear the verified or locked flag on one column's cells across every document a filter selects in a matter, working in batches until the whole selection is covered. Folders and tasks are never touched. Returns how many cells changed plus an addedAt stamp: pass that stamp back as onlyAddedAt with set false to undo exactly this mark and leave flags from other marks alone. Pass groupByPropertyId and groupValue to restrict the batch to one group of a grouped view.
name: capability:fields.column-flag.update
title: fields.column-flag.update

description: Move one entity across writable Kanban axes in one transaction. The request may change a task status, up to two property values, or both.
name: capability:fields.kanban-placement.update
title: fields.kanban-placement.update

description: Set a document's value for a property (a cell in the matter's table). Pass the document entityId, the propertyId (from list_properties), and a content object whose 'type' matches the property's value type: text (value: string), single-select (value: string or null), multi-select (value: array of strings), date (value: ISO YYYY-MM-DD or null), or int (value: integer, optional currency: 3-letter ISO code). An empty value clears the cell.
name: capability:fields.upsert
title: fields.upsert
