description: Create an automation flow definition in the organization: name, description, ordered steps, a trigger, and whether it is enabled. The definition is validated before it is stored, and a schedule trigger is registered with the scheduler afterwards. Refused once the organization holds its maximum number of flows.
name: capability:flows.create
title: flows.create

description: Permanently delete one automation flow definition from the organization and remove its schedule trigger. Past runs survive on their own definition snapshot; an enabled flow with runs in flight is deleted without warning.
name: capability:flows.delete
title: flows.delete

description: Read one flow definition: its name, description, steps, trigger, and enabled flag. Use flows.list to browse the organization's flows and flows.runs.get to read a run of one.
name: capability:flows.get
title: flows.get

description: List flow definitions available to the organization, with optional status filtering and pagination.
name: capability:flows.list
title: flows.list

description: Cancel a flow run that is still in progress in a matter, returning the run id and the status it settled on. Work already committed by steps that finished is not undone.
name: capability:flows.runs.cancel
title: flows.runs.cancel

description: Read one flow run, including its current status, inputs, outputs, steps, and review state.
name: capability:flows.runs.get
title: flows.runs.get

description: List flow runs in a matter, including lifecycle state and pagination metadata.
name: capability:flows.runs.list
title: flows.runs.list

description: Resolve a flow run waiting at a review gate: pass decision approved or rejected, with an optional note. The run continues or stops accordingly, and its id and new status come back.
name: capability:flows.runs.review
title: flows.runs.review

description: Start a manual flow run in a matter using a flow definition and optional input documents. Returns the run ID and initial status.
name: capability:flows.runs.start
title: flows.runs.start

description: Replace one flow definition's name, description, steps, trigger, and enabled flag. The whole definition is revalidated and written, so this is not a partial update. The scheduler row is reconciled afterwards, so changing or removing a schedule trigger, or disabling the flow, also stops it from firing.
name: capability:flows.update
title: flows.update

description: Create a draft invoice from approved, not-yet-invoiced client time entries in a matter, marking them billed. Hourly invoices require billable entries in the invoice currency and calculate time charges from their billed minutes and recorded rates; nothing is converted. The optional invoice number must not already be in use. An omitted number is allocated from the document type’s default series at finalize. Credit notes require an original finalized, sent, or paid invoice in the same matter. A flat-fee matter snapshots its agreed fee as one protected manual line; selected approved client entries are covered without time charges. Hourly matters reserve time charges against any cap and refuse an excess without write-down. Pass empty timeEntryIds for a draft with manual lines. expenseIds bills approved expenses in the same call. entryAdjustments sets billed minutes and no-charge on included entries first (approvers only). The draft is prefilled like invoices.prefill returns it: the default seller profile (or sellerProfileId), the buyer copied from the matter's client, every line's VAT from the seller's VAT-payer flag and the buyer (not a VAT payer, reverse charge when the client's VAT ID names another country, or the highest organization VAT rate in force), the taxable supply date as the last included work day, and the due date from the client's payment term or 14 days; explicit dueDate and taxableSupplyDate win. Without a seller profile, lines keep 0 % VAT. Credit notes are not prefilled.
name: capability:invoices.create
title: invoices.create

description: Delete a draft invoice and return every time entry and expense on it to approved, unbilled status so they can be invoiced again. Only draft invoices that have never been issued can be deleted; issued invoices require a credit note even after reverting to draft.
name: capability:invoices.delete
title: invoices.delete

description: Attach approved, billable, not-yet-invoiced time entries and expenses to a draft invoice as invoice lines without VAT, marking them billed and recomputing the invoice totals. Every entry must match the invoice currency, because an invoice is single-currency and nothing is converted. Only never-issued drafts accept entries; issued invoices require a credit note even after reverting to draft. A concurrent change to the same entries fails with a retryable conflict rather than attaching part of the set.
name: capability:invoices.entries.add
title: invoices.entries.add

description: Detach time entries and expenses from a draft invoice, removing their invoice lines, returning them to approved, unbilled status, and recomputing the invoice totals. Reversible: the same entries can be attached again with invoices.entries.add, and the entries themselves are kept. Only never-issued drafts may be changed; issued invoices require a credit note even after reverting to draft. Ids that are not on this invoice are skipped without an error.
name: capability:invoices.entries.remove
title: invoices.entries.remove

description: Export a matter's issued invoices, advance invoices and credit notes (drafts and void invoices excluded) as a spreadsheet, an accounting import file (POHODA, Money S3, ABRA Flexi, ESO9), ISDOC, UBL (EN 16931), Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 for Slovak sellers or Polish KSeF FA(3) e-invoices, or a LEDES 1998B e-billing file. Pass invoiceIds to export a selection; one export holds at most 500 invoices. Refused when a format cannot hold the data. Returns a short-lived downloadUrl, fileName and expiresAt; hand the URL to the user without reading the file bytes.
name: capability:invoices.export
title: invoices.export

description: Read one invoice with its full detail: its lines in order with quantity, unit price, VAT, and amounts; totals with the VAT breakdown by rate; document type, original invoice id, seller profile, buyer, dates, currency, and status; its payments with the paid and outstanding amounts; and every attached time entry and expense with its work item. An invoice from before invoice lines lists no lines for its attached entries until its first line edit; its totals still count them. Use invoices.list for a paginated summary without lines.
name: capability:invoices.get
title: invoices.get

description: Add one line to a draft invoice and recompute its totals. The source is a manual line (description, decimal quantity, optional unit, unit price in minor units), an approved unbilled time entry, or an approved unbilled expense; an entry line takes its amount from the entry and marks the entry billed. Every line carries a VAT rate in basis points and a VAT treatment. Only never-issued drafts accept lines; issued invoices require a credit note even after reverting to draft.
name: capability:invoices.lines.create
title: invoices.lines.create

description: Remove one line from a draft invoice and recompute its totals. A time entry or expense line returns its entry to approved, unbilled status, so it can be billed again. Only never-issued drafts can be edited; issued invoices require a credit note even after reverting to draft.
name: capability:invoices.lines.delete
title: invoices.lines.delete

description: Change one line of a draft invoice and recompute its totals. Any line accepts description, quantity, unit price, and VAT overrides without changing the source time entry or expense. Set resetToRecorded to true alone to restore the recorded description, quantity, unit and price. Recorded values remain available for reporting. A flat-fee line keeps its snapshotted quantity, unit, and price; its description and VAT may change. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Only drafts that have never been issued can be edited; issued invoices require a credit note, even after reverting to draft.
name: capability:invoices.lines.update
title: invoices.lines.update

description: List a matter's invoices oldest first with cursor pagination, returning each invoice's number (null before numbering), document type, original invoice id, reference, status, dates, currency, language, total, and paid and outstanding amounts, but not its line items. Use invoices.get to read the attached time entries and expenses.
name: capability:invoices.list
title: invoices.list

description: Record a payment on a finalized or sent invoice: amount in minor units of the invoice currency, paidOn no later than today. Reaching the total marks it paid; more than the outstanding amount is refused.
name: capability:invoices.payments.create
title: invoices.payments.create

description: List an invoice's payments oldest first, voided ones included, with its paid and outstanding amounts in minor units.
name: capability:invoices.payments.list
title: invoices.payments.list

description: Void a mistaken invoice payment. The payment stays on record as voided; a paid invoice it no longer covers returns to its prior status.
name: capability:invoices.payments.void
title: invoices.payments.void

description: Download an invoice, advance invoice or credit note as PDF, including its parties, lines, VAT breakdown and payment QR. Drafts have no document number. Returns a short-lived downloadUrl, fileName and expiresAt; hand the URL to the user without reading the file bytes.
name: capability:invoices.pdf.export
title: invoices.pdf.export

description: Prepare a new invoice for a matter without creating it: the matter's approved, billable, not-yet-invoiced time entries (with timekeeper names) and approved billable expenses, oldest first (a matter with more than 500 of either is refused); the proposed currency, issue date (today in the organization's zone) and payment term; the default seller profile (or sellerProfileId); the buyer copied from the matter's client; the VAT treatment and rate the lines would get, each with where it came from; and the organization's VAT rate periods, since billing fewer items can move the supply date into another rate. Pass the chosen ids to invoices.create, which applies the same prefill.
name: capability:invoices.prefill
title: invoices.prefill

description: Move an invoice through finalize, send, void, or revert_to_draft; recording payments that reach its total marks it paid. Finalize assigns an omitted number from the document type's default series, using the issue date; configure a default number series first. Manual numbers and numbers kept after reverting to draft are preserved. A credit note must reference an eligible original and cannot exceed its total. Voiding releases attached entries; it and reverting are refused while unvoided payments remain. Finalizing a VAT invoice in a currency other than its seller country's VAT currency (EUR for Slovakia, CZK for Czechia, PLN for Poland) records the official exchange rate for its tax point and states the VAT in that currency; it is refused when the rate cannot be resolved.
name: capability:invoices.transition
title: invoices.transition

description: Change a draft invoice's number, issue date (invoiceDate), taxable supply date, due date, reference, notes, currency, issuing seller profile, or buyer details as they should read on the document. Omitted fields stay unchanged; null clears an optional field. Only draft invoices can be edited. Type and original invoice become immutable after the first finalize, including after reverting to draft. Credit notes require an eligible original in the same matter. Currency cannot change while the invoice has lines or attached entries.
name: capability:invoices.update
title: invoices.update

description: Leave a highlight or comment on a passage of a case-law decision or a statute version; private unless shared.
name: capability:legal-reader.annotations.create
title: legal-reader.annotations.create

description: Permanently delete one of the caller's highlights or comments.
name: capability:legal-reader.annotations.delete
title: legal-reader.annotations.delete

description: List the highlights and comments on one decision or statute version: the caller's own and those colleagues shared.
name: capability:legal-reader.annotations.list
title: legal-reader.annotations.list

description: Change one of the caller's highlights or comments: its words, colour, style, or visibility.
name: capability:legal-reader.annotations.update
title: legal-reader.annotations.update

description: Read the block outline of one consolidated Spanish BOE law: its parts, articles, and provisions with the block ids that address them. Use legislation.boe.text-block.get to fetch the text of a single block.
name: capability:legislation.boe.law-structure.get
title: legislation.boe.law-structure.get

description: Read one consolidated Spanish law from the BOE by its BOE-X-YYYY-N identifier. The metadata, analysis, fullText, and eli flags select which blocks the BOE returns; this queries the BOE service directly rather than the stella legislation corpus.
name: capability:legislation.boe.laws.get
title: legislation.boe.laws.get

description: List the Spanish BOE laws related to one law, narrowed by relationType: modifies, modifiedBy, derogates, derogatedBy, or all (the default).
name: capability:legislation.boe.related-laws.list
title: legislation.boe.related-laws.list

description: Search Spanish consolidated legislation on the BOE. At least one filter is required: free text, title, department code, legal-range code (law rank), subject-matter code, or a publication date range as YYYYMMDD. Paginate with limit and the opaque cursor. This queries the BOE service live; use the search_legislation tool to search the stella legislation corpus instead.
name: capability:legislation.boe.search
title: legislation.boe.search

description: Read the text of one block of a consolidated Spanish BOE law, addressed by the law identifier and a block id taken from legislation.boe.law-structure.get.
name: capability:legislation.boe.text-block.get
title: legislation.boe.text-block.get

description: Read the BORME summary the Spanish commercial registry gazette published on one date, given as YYYYMMDD.
name: capability:legislation.borme.summary.get
title: legislation.borme.summary.get

description: Read one legislation document from the stella corpus by id: its ELI, title, country, language, document type, status, effective and version-validity dates, source links, and parsed structure. Full text is returned only when the parsed structure is missing or unusable, and is null otherwise. Only documents from sources cleared for redistribution are returned; anything else reads as not found.
name: capability:legislation.get
title: legislation.get

description: Full-text search the stella legislation corpus, returning ranked results with strict or relaxed match metadata, a highlighted snippet and each document's ELI, title, country, language, type, status, effective date, and the matched version's validity window. Use asOf to search the consolidation in force on an ISO date; omit it to include historical wording. Filter by jurisdiction, document type, status, source, language, and effective-date range; paginate with limit and cursor. Admitted jurisdiction codes (uppercase): CZE, SVK. Omit jurisdiction to search all admitted jurisdictions. Only admitted jurisdictions and sources cleared for redistribution are searched. Read a hit in full with legislation.read; use legislation.boe.search to query the Spanish BOE service directly instead.
name: capability:legislation.search
title: legislation.search

description: Add a column to a list by binding one of the matter's properties to it, with an optional position and a required flag. The list must be active and the property must belong to the same matter. A property can be bound only once per list: binding it again returns the existing column rather than creating a second one, except once the list holds its maximum number of columns, where the cap is checked first and the call is refused.
name: capability:lists.columns.create
title: lists.columns.create

description: Create a list in a matter from a name and an optional description; it starts active and empty. Refused once the matter holds its maximum number of lists. Add structure afterwards with lists.sections.create and lists.columns.create.
name: capability:lists.create
title: lists.create

description: Accept one candidate from a generation run: create the item it proposes as a task in the matter, optionally in a named section, and copy the candidate's sources onto the new item with their locators and quotes. The candidate is claimed before the item is created, so two concurrent accepts cannot both produce one, and the run flips to committed once no candidate is left pending. A candidate whose sources have disappeared is refused and the reserved item is cleaned up.
name: capability:lists.generation-candidates.acceptance.create
title: lists.generation-candidates.acceptance.create

description: Submit the candidates a generation run produced: per candidate a name, description, item type, status, priority, due date, suggested assignees, and the sources it was drawn from, each naming a document version with a locator and optional quote. Every source must be one of the run's own source versions. The run moves from running to review; candidates stay proposals until they are accepted or rejected.
name: capability:lists.generation-candidates.create
title: lists.generation-candidates.create

description: List one generation run's candidates in proposal order with cursor pagination: the proposed item fields, the candidate's status, the item it was accepted as when it has one, and the sources it cites. The run's own status is returned alongside the page.
name: capability:lists.generation-candidates.list
title: lists.generation-candidates.list

description: Reject one pending candidate of a generation run so it is never turned into a list item. Only a pending candidate can be rejected; the run flips to committed once nothing is left pending. Nothing is deleted: the candidate stays in the run with status rejected.
name: capability:lists.generation-candidates.rejection.create
title: lists.generation-candidates.rejection.create

description: Start a generation run over a list: an instruction plus the document versions to read, each named by its entity and version id and each appearing once. Every source must be a live document version in this matter. Returns the run id with status running; the candidates it produces are submitted separately and leave the run in review.
name: capability:lists.generations.create
title: lists.generations.create

description: List one list's generation runs, newest first, with cursor pagination: each run's status, its instruction, and its created, updated, and completed timestamps.
name: capability:lists.generations.list
title: lists.generations.list

description: Read one list with its sections in order, its columns (each bound property with its position and required flag), and how many items it holds. The items themselves come from lists.items.list.
name: capability:lists.get
title: lists.get

description: Read one list item's activity trail, newest first with cursor pagination: the audit entries recorded against the item and against the task behind it, each with its action, the actor's name, the recorded changes, and the operation label. changesStatus is visible or feature_unavailable; non-visible changes and operation are null.
name: capability:lists.items.activity.list
title: lists.items.activity.list

description: Add a comment to one list item. The comment is stored against the item and shows up in its activity trail.
name: capability:lists.items.comments.create
title: lists.items.comments.create

description: Set the evidential detail of one fact item, replacing what it had: when it happened (a date with day, month or year precision; a partial date is stored as its first day), what kind of evidence and medium carry it, how unambiguous its meaning is (confidence; null when not stated), a note where that meaning is contested, and whether verifications may rely on it (`held` keeps it out until confirmed). Only `fact` items carry detail.
name: capability:lists.items.fact-details.update
title: lists.items.fact-details.update

description: List one list's items in list order with cursor pagination. Each item carries its name, item type, task status, priority, due date, section, position, description, and review status, plus the values it holds for the properties the list binds as columns. A fact item also carries its evidential detail (date and precision, evidence kind, medium, confidence and interpretation note), null until it is set, and its first source (document id, document name, locator), null when it has none.
name: capability:lists.items.list
title: lists.items.list

description: Record a review decision on one list item, with an optional note. The item's review status becomes that decision and the decision is appended to the item's review history; an unrecognized decision is refused.
name: capability:lists.items.reviews.update
title: lists.items.reviews.update

description: Attach a source to one list item: the document version it comes from plus a locator (the whole document, a DOCX block, or a PDF page) and an optional quote. The source must be a live document version in this matter.
name: capability:lists.items.sources.create
title: lists.items.sources.create

description: List the sources attached to one list item with cursor pagination, each with the document version it points at, its locator, and its quote.
name: capability:lists.items.sources.list
title: lists.items.sources.list

description: Set the verification status of one source attached to a list item. Any status other than unverified records who set it and when; setting it back to unverified clears both.
name: capability:lists.items.sources.verification.update
title: lists.items.sources.verification.update

description: Change one list item's section, its ordering position within the list, or its description; only the fields you pass are written, and a section that does not belong to this list is refused. The item's name, status, priority, and due date live on the task behind it, so change those with tasks.update.
name: capability:lists.items.update
title: lists.items.update

description: List a matter's lists, newest first, with cursor pagination, filtered by status (active by default, archived on request). Each entry carries the name, description, status, and timestamps.
name: capability:lists.list
title: lists.list

description: Load the bundled AVT sample case into the current matter: one fact list with 19 facts and their evidential details, plus a DOCX witness statement. The list, facts and document are committed together. Repeating this call returns the same listId, documentEntityId and fileFieldId without changing the sample, even after renaming it. Once its document or a sample fact is deleted, the call loads a fresh complete sample with new IDs. Requires access to list verification. Use lists.verifications.create with listId, entityId=documentEntityId and fileFieldId to check the statement.
name: capability:lists.sample-case.create
title: lists.sample-case.create

description: Add a section to an active list, with a name and an optional ordering position. Refused when the list is not active or already holds its maximum number of sections.
name: capability:lists.sections.create
title: lists.sections.create

description: Rename a list, change its description, or move it between active and archived. Only the fields you pass are written, an unrecognized status is refused, and a call that changes nothing is a no-op rather than an error.
name: capability:lists.update
title: lists.update

description: Comment on one claim of a list verification, as the user. The comment covers the claim's own words; it is private unless visibility is shared, which shows it to everyone who can open the matter. Resending the same requestId returns the comment it already made.
name: capability:lists.verifications.claim-comments.create
title: lists.verifications.claim-comments.create

description: Permanently delete one of the user's comments on a list verification claim.
name: capability:lists.verifications.claim-comments.delete
title: lists.verifications.claim-comments.delete

description: List the comments on one claim of a list verification that the user can see: their own, and those colleagues on the matter shared, oldest first with cursor pagination. Each comment names its author and whether it is the user's own.
name: capability:lists.verifications.claim-comments.list
title: lists.verifications.claim-comments.list

description: Change one of the user's comments on a list verification claim: its words (`body`) or who sees it (`visibility`: private, or shared with everyone who can open the matter).
name: capability:lists.verifications.claim-comments.update
title: lists.verifications.claim-comments.update

description: Mark the routine claims among `claimIds` reviewed in one action. A claim is routine when its verdict is not a conflict and no fact it rests on has a contested meaning; those need an individual decision and are refused. Claims that already have a status are left as they are. Returns the review of every claim that was marked.
name: capability:lists.verifications.claim-reviews.bulk.create
title: lists.verifications.claim-reviews.bulk.create

description: Record one reviewer action on a claim of a list verification and return the claim's review after it. `status` marks the claim reviewed or disputed (null clears it); `override` annotates the verdict with the reviewer's own state, beside the tool's, never replacing it; `note` sets the review note; `reopen` reclassifies a set-aside claim as checkable; `record-conflict` resolves a claim withheld between two records by naming the governing fact or escalating it. Reopening and resolving a conflict withdraw an earlier status and override.
name: capability:lists.verifications.claim-reviews.create
title: lists.verifications.claim-reviews.create

description: Start checking one document (DOCX, PDF, or a file with a PDF rendition) against the facts of one list. Every claim the document makes is found and, when factual, graded against the list's facts (held facts are left out). Returns a run id; read the result with lists.verifications.get. A document holds one unfinished verification at a time.
name: capability:lists.verifications.create
title: lists.verifications.create

description: Read one list verification: the document version it checked, the list facts it checked against as they stood then, and every claim found in the document with its verdict (state, and a 0-100 support score for supported, tension and contradicted), the facts it rests on, and the claim's current review (null while nobody has acted on it).
name: capability:lists.verifications.get
title: lists.verifications.get

description: Read the latest list verification of each named document file (entity id and file field id), in one call: its status, failure code, the list it checked against, when it started and finished, and claim counts per verdict state. A file never verified is absent from the answer. Earlier runs are in lists.verifications.list.
name: capability:lists.verifications.latest.list
title: lists.verifications.latest.list

description: List the list verifications of one document, newest first with cursor pagination: each run's status, failure code, the list it checked against, when it was started and finished, and how many claims landed in each verdict state. Read one run in full with lists.verifications.get.
name: capability:lists.verifications.list
title: lists.verifications.list

description: Add a never-mask entry to a matter's anonymization allowlist, so a term that detection finds is left in the clear. scope workspace covers the whole matter; scope document covers one document and needs an entityId belonging to this matter. Only matter-scoped entries can be created here, never organization-wide ones. A term already listed is a no-op, until the matter reaches its allowlist limit: the cap is checked before the duplicate is detected, so replaying an existing entry is refused there rather than reported as a no-op.
name: capability:matters.anonymization-allowlist.create
title: matters.anonymization-allowlist.create

description: Remove one anonymization allowlist entry from a matter, so the term it exempted is masked again from the next detection run on. Only entries scoped to this matter can be removed here, never organization-wide ones, and output already anonymized is not revisited.
name: capability:matters.anonymization-allowlist.delete
title: matters.anonymization-allowlist.delete

description: Read the never-mask entries that apply in a matter: the organization-wide ones plus the matter's own and, when entityId is given, that document's own, merged into one list so a detection run can be filtered in a single pass.
name: capability:matters.anonymization-allowlist.list
title: matters.anonymization-allowlist.list

description: Add always-mask terms to a matter's anonymization gazetteer, each with a canonical form, a label, and optional spelling variants. Idempotent per canonical form: a term the matter already holds is left as it is and not counted as inserted. Refused when the batch would push the matter past its term limit. Organization-wide terms are managed separately.
name: capability:matters.anonymization-terms.create
title: matters.anonymization-terms.create

description: Remove one always-mask term from a matter's anonymization gazetteer, so it is no longer force-masked and is redacted only when detection finds it on its own. Only entries scoped to this matter can be removed here, never organization-wide ones; text already sent to a provider is unaffected.
name: capability:matters.anonymization-terms.delete
title: matters.anonymization-terms.delete

description: Read a matter's own always-mask terms with their canonical form, label, variants, and enabled flag. Organization-wide terms are not included; read those with organization-settings.anonymization-blacklist.get.
name: capability:matters.anonymization-terms.list
title: matters.anonymization-terms.list

description: Archive a matter: it stops being writable and is cleared from members' last-visited matter. Reversible with matters.unarchive, and nothing is deleted. Refused while document processing is running in the matter or any timer is still running there.
name: capability:matters.archive
title: matters.archive

description: Re-run the AI extraction for one cell, meaning one document's value for one AI column, in a matter. Refused when the property is not AI-extracted, when the document is read-only, when the cell is locked, and while another workflow is already running in the matter.
name: capability:matters.cells.retry
title: matters.cells.retry

description: Link a contact to a matter in a party role (opposing party/counsel, co-counsel, witness, expert witness, third party, judge, mediator, or other). Pass contactId with role to link. When the matter reaches its contact limit, remove an existing contact link before adding another.
name: capability:matters.contacts.create
title: matters.contacts.create

description: Remove one contact from a matter's party list, deleting the link with the party role and notes recorded on it. The contact stays in the organization address book; use contacts.delete to remove it from there.
name: capability:matters.contacts.delete
title: matters.contacts.delete

description: Read one matter correspondence record with its filers and attachments. When intake is not direct, from, to, and the message date (sentAt) are asserted by the forwarder and are not verified; authentication verdicts in authenticatedSender describe the delivery, not the extracted original. A record whose source is upload was read from the email file sourceEntityId in the matter; its headers are as stated in that file and are not verified.
name: capability:matters.correspondence.get
title: matters.correspondence.get

description: List correspondence filed in a matter, newest received first. When intake is not direct, from, to, and the message date (sentAt) are asserted by the forwarder and are not verified; authentication verdicts in authenticatedSender describe the delivery, not the extracted original. A record whose source is upload was read from the email file sourceEntityId in the matter; its headers are as stated in that file and are not verified.
name: capability:matters.correspondence.list
title: matters.correspondence.list

description: Update supplied handling fields of a matter correspondence record. Omitted fields stay unchanged; null assignee clears assignment.
name: capability:matters.correspondence.update
title: matters.correspondence.update

description: Create a new matter (name required; pass clientId to attach a client contact). Returns the matter ID.
name: capability:matters.create
title: matters.create

description: Permanently delete a matter with its documents, tasks, fields and chat history; irreversible. Refused (409) when it has time, expenses or invoices: archive it instead.
name: capability:matters.delete
title: matters.delete

description: Copy a matter into a new one: its columns with their dependencies, views, members, party contacts, client, billing reference, colour, and lead. With includeContent true its documents, folders, tasks, and their stored files are copied as well; with false the new matter starts empty. The copy takes the organization's next matter number and its name gains a numeric suffix when earlier copies exist. Refused once the organization is at its matter limit.
name: capability:matters.duplicate
title: matters.duplicate

description: Read the stored justifications for the current versions of up to one page of documents in a matter: per extracted cell, the explanation the model gave, the bounding boxes on the source file, and the file fields those boxes belong to.
name: capability:matters.justifications.list
title: matters.justifications.list

description: List the matters you can access.
name: capability:matters.list
title: matters.list

description: Add one member of the organization to a matter, granting them access to it. A user who is already a member is a 409, and the call is refused once the matter holds its maximum number of members. Revoke access with matters.members.remove.
name: capability:matters.members.add
title: matters.members.add

description: List a matter's members, each with their user's id, name, email and image, as the people its tasks can be assigned to. Add one with matters.members.add.
name: capability:matters.members.list
title: matters.members.list

description: Remove one member from a matter, revoking their live access and cancelling their open desktop editing sessions. Their active work obligations are unassigned rather than deleted; refused when they are the matter's last member, when a timer of theirs is still running, or when they own more work obligations than one call may unassign at once.
name: capability:matters.members.remove
title: matters.members.remove

description: Return bounded task and document highlights for a matter search-result preview.
name: capability:matters.search-preview.get
title: matters.search-preview.get

description: Return an archived matter to active so it is writable again. The counterpart of matters.archive: a matter that is not archived is left exactly as it is.
name: capability:matters.unarchive
title: matters.unarchive

description: Change a matter: its name, client, reference, billing reference, colour, or lead (who must already be a member of it). Only the fields you pass are written. clientId attaches a client to a personal matter or replaces the client of a client matter; members are managed separately. Pass expectedClientId (null for a personal matter) to change the client only if its current assignment still matches; otherwise returns version_conflict.
name: capability:matters.update
title: matters.update

description: Read a matter's names, references, linked contacts, tracked case numbers, locally known court names, and most recently created document titles. Returns up to 32 candidates per kind and 128 total; terms longer than 512 characters are omitted. Candidates preserve spelling and include a kind weight and available activity timestamp. Requires a matter id; returns not found when unavailable.
name: capability:matters.vocabulary.get
title: matters.vocabulary.get

description: Report whether an extraction workflow is running in a matter and describe its most recent run: scope, status, how many targets it covers and how many are done, error code, and start and finish times.
name: capability:matters.workflow.get
title: matters.workflow.get

description: Start an extraction workflow in a matter, filling the AI columns of the documents that need it. Narrow it with entityIds and propertyIds, set the processing order with entityIdsOrder, and choose serviceTier standard or flex, where flex is the cheaper deferred tier and is refused when the configured provider does not offer it. Returns the run's status, including already-running when one is in flight.
name: capability:matters.workflow.start
title: matters.workflow.start

description: Count the documents an extraction workflow would process in a matter, optionally narrowed to a set of entity ids. Use it before matters.workflow.start to size the run.
name: capability:matters.workflow.targets.count
title: matters.workflow.targets.count

description: Save an assistant memory that future chats will read. scope user is private to you and takes kind preference or instruction; scope workspace belongs to one active matter (matterId) and also takes fact, decision or relationship, and needs permission to update that matter. Content identical to an existing memory returns that memory's id with type existing, or reactivated when it was archived, instead of a duplicate. Firm-wide memory cannot be created here.
name: capability:memories.create
title: memories.create

description: List the assistant memories you can see, newest first: firm-wide memory, your own, and memory of matters you can access. Archived memories are left out unless status asks for them. Narrow by scope (organization, user, workspace = a matter), status, or matterId.
name: capability:memories.list
title: memories.list

description: Change one assistant memory: accept a suggested memory (status active), retire it (status archived), pin or unpin it, or edit its content. Archiving is how a memory is removed; an archived memory must be set active again before its content can change. Firm-wide memory needs firm-memory permission, matter memory needs permission to update that active matter.
name: capability:memories.update
title: memories.update

description: List the caller's own notifications in their active organization, newest first, with the unread count. Notifications are awareness pointers (mentions, finished exports, flow-run outcomes, announcements) and carry no work state; they are read or unread and nothing else.
name: capability:notifications.list
title: notifications.list

description: Mark one of the caller's notifications read. Idempotent: marking an already-read notification succeeds and changes nothing. Answers with the caller's remaining unread count.
name: capability:notifications.read-state.update
title: notifications.read-state.update

description: Archive a number series so it cannot allocate another number.
name: capability:number-series.archive
title: number-series.archive

description: Create a document number series in the active organization.
name: capability:number-series.create
title: number-series.create

description: Set the default active series for its document type.
name: capability:number-series.default.update
title: number-series.default.update

description: Read one active document number series.
name: capability:number-series.get
title: number-series.get

description: List active document number series in the active organization.
name: capability:number-series.list
title: number-series.list

description: Preview the next number for a date without reserving it. A concurrent issue can change the result.
name: capability:number-series.preview
title: number-series.preview

description: Update an active number series. Pattern and padding lock after first allocation.
name: capability:number-series.update
title: number-series.update

description: Report whether AI is usable in this organization: whether the deployment provides a model, whether the organization has configured its own provider, whether either of those makes AI available at all, whether the reduced-cost deferred service tier can be used, and whether a local development stack answers with canned replies instead of a model, why AI is unavailable, and whether this principal may configure the organization's provider. Any member may read it.
name: capability:organization-settings.ai-availability.get
title: organization-settings.ai-availability.get

description: Read the organization-wide always-mask terms: each entry's canonical form, label, spelling variants, and enabled flag. Matter-scoped terms live in the same table but are never returned here; read those with matters.anonymization-terms.list.
name: capability:organization-settings.anonymization-blacklist.get
title: organization-settings.anonymization-blacklist.get

description: Replace the organization-wide always-mask list with the entries you pass: terms not in the list are deleted, terms already present are updated, and the rest are inserted, so this is a whole-list replacement rather than a merge, and an empty list clears every organization-wide term. Matter-scoped terms in the same table are left untouched.
name: capability:organization-settings.anonymization-blacklist.update
title: organization-settings.anonymization-blacklist.update

description: Approve a shared mailbox address for filing correspondence.
name: capability:organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.create
title: organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.create

description: Revoke an approved shared mailbox sender while retaining its approval history.
name: capability:organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.delete
title: organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.delete

description: List approved and revoked shared mailbox senders for the active organization.
name: capability:organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.list
title: organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.list

description: Allow an approved shared mailbox to file correspondence for one matter.
name: capability:organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.scope.add
title: organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.scope.add

description: Remove one matter from a shared mailbox sender's filing scope.
name: capability:organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.scope.remove
title: organization-settings.correspondence.allowed-senders.scope.remove

description: Report whether the organization has a translation provider key configured, as a single boolean. Nothing about the key itself, not even a masked preview, is returned here.
name: capability:organization-settings.deepl-availability.get
title: organization-settings.deepl-availability.get

description: Report whether this deployment accepts document OCR requests: `live` when a worker is processing now, `batched` when queued requests run in the next recognition batch, `unconfigured` when requests would not run.
name: capability:organization-settings.document-ocr-availability.get
title: organization-settings.document-ocr-availability.get

description: Read the organization's general settings: document processing mode, matter-number pattern, padding, and whether titles show that number, practice jurisdictions, prompt caching, memory extraction, time policy, and the time zone whose calendar decides the organization's day. declaredFeatureIds identifies policies in force; capabilities contains caller decisions; deploymentFeatures supplies deployment availability. timeZoneSource says whether the zone was chosen or derived from the primary practice jurisdiction (Europe/Prague for CZ and SK, UTC otherwise). primaryJurisdictionTimeZone is the zone the primary jurisdiction implies, regardless of an organization override. An organization that has never saved settings gets the defaults rather than an error.
name: capability:organization-settings.get
title: organization-settings.get

description: Set the practice jurisdictions for the user's stella organization. Call this when the org's practice jurisdictions are empty (e.g., the user signed up via an OAuth client and skipped onboarding). Pass an array of {countryCode, isPrimary}; exactly one entry should be primary.
name: capability:organization-settings.practice-jurisdictions.update
title: organization-settings.practice-jurisdictions.update

description: Preview the matter number a pattern would produce next: the pattern and padding are validated, the counter for the scope that pattern falls in is read, and the rendered reference is returned with the sequence value it would take. Nothing is stored and no counter is advanced.
name: capability:organization-settings.preview
title: organization-settings.preview

description: Enable or disable sanctions monitoring for the active organization. Disabling hides active hits and preserves history. Enabling queues a bounded backfill; contact opt-outs still apply. Read contacts.sanctions.get for eventual screening results. Changes are audited.
name: capability:organization-settings.sanctions-monitoring.update
title: organization-settings.sanctions-monitoring.update

description: Change the organization's general settings: document processing mode, matter-number pattern, padding, whether titles show that number, prompt caching, memory extraction, time policy, and time zone. Only the fields you pass are written and the matter-number pattern is validated against its padding first. Turning document processing off is refused while an automatic run is still going. Practice jurisdictions are set through organization-settings.practice-jurisdictions.update.
name: capability:organization-settings.update
title: organization-settings.update

description: Change the active organization's slug. Owners and admins may choose a lowercase slug or generate an opaque org- identifier. The old slug has no alias. A taken slug returns organization_slug_conflict; choose another or use type opaque.
name: capability:organizations.slug.update
title: organizations.slug.update

description: Run every applicable playbook over a matter in one pass and materialize their columns onto its table: a playbook with no document-type scope always applies, one scoped to a document type only when that type is present among the matter's classified documents. Each playbook pins its own latest approved version and opens its own per-document runs; a playbook that hits a limit is skipped while the rest continue. Returns typed per-playbook refusals (code, status, message, hint, retryable), how many playbooks ran, how many columns were materialized, and how many document runs opened. Use playbooks.run for a single playbook.
name: capability:playbooks.applicable.run
title: playbooks.applicable.run

description: Approve a playbook definition: snapshot its current name, description, scope, and positions as a new immutable version, then mark the definition approved. Runs pin the latest approved version, so this is what publishes edits to reviews. Pass expectedUpdatedAt as a concurrency token; a definition that changed since you read it is a conflict. Approving an already-approved playbook is allowed and simply appends another version.
name: capability:playbooks.approve
title: playbooks.approve

description: Create a playbook definition in the organization from a name, an optional description, an optional document-type scope, and its positions. The positions are validated and the automatic questions derived from their tier rules before storage. It starts as a draft: approve it with playbooks.approve before runs will use it.
name: capability:playbooks.create
title: playbooks.create

description: Permanently delete a playbook definition and every approved version of it from the organization. Columns the playbook materialized into matters are kept: they keep their extracted answers and verdicts and continue to work as ordinary columns, no longer owned by any playbook. Recorded review findings are kept as well. There is no in-use check.
name: capability:playbooks.delete
title: playbooks.delete

description: Save the position list a completed document review ran against as a new draft playbook in the organization, taking the same create path a hand-authored playbook takes (validation, the per-organization limit, the draft status). Position ids are preserved, so decisions already taken on those positions stay attached to them.
name: capability:playbooks.from-run.create
title: playbooks.from-run.create

description: Create or reopen the organization's playbook from a bundled starter, cloning its positions with fresh ids on first use and otherwise taking exactly the path playbooks.create takes, including validation, the per-organization limit, and the draft status. Repeated use of one starter returns the existing playbook instead of creating a copy. Browse the starters with playbooks.starters.list.
name: capability:playbooks.from-starter.create
title: playbooks.from-starter.create

description: Read one playbook definition in full: its name, description, document-type scope, positions, status, approval metadata, and how the organization has decided each position across past reviews. positionSources names the source documents of its positions that the caller can open. Use playbooks.list for the paginated overview.
name: capability:playbooks.get
title: playbooks.get

description: List the organization's playbook definitions with cursor pagination, each with its scope, status, and approval metadata. Read one playbook's positions in full with playbooks.get.
name: capability:playbooks.list
title: playbooks.list

description: List the current user's recently used playbooks in the active organization.
name: capability:playbooks.recent.list
title: playbooks.recent.list

description: Run a review playbook over a matter's documents. Every DOCX document is reviewed against the playbook's latest approved version, and each document's findings are recorded against its own pinned version. Pass matterId, playbookId, and the projection: "columns" also materializes the playbook's extraction and verdict columns onto the table, "none" materializes none. Findings populate asynchronously.
name: capability:playbooks.run
title: playbooks.run

description: List the bundled starter playbooks available to instantiate: each starter's id, name, description, target document type, and how many positions it holds. Metadata only, enough to render a picker; create one with playbooks.from-starter.create.
name: capability:playbooks.starters.list
title: playbooks.starters.list

description: Replace a playbook definition's name, description, scope, and positions; the positions are validated and their automatic questions re-derived. Any edit invalidates a prior approval, so the playbook drops back to draft with its approval metadata cleared and runs keep using the last approved version until it is approved again. Pass expectedUpdatedAt as a concurrency token; a definition changed since you read it is a conflict, and the new updatedAt comes back for the next save.
name: capability:playbooks.update
title: playbooks.update

description: List one playbook's approval history, newest version first: the version number, the name it carried at that version, when it was created, and by whom. A version is only written when a playbook is approved, so the list is capped rather than cursor-paginated.
name: capability:playbooks.versions.list
title: playbooks.versions.list

description: Restore a stored playbook version by copying its name, description, scope, and positions back onto the definition. A restore counts as an edit: the playbook returns to draft with its approval metadata cleared, so it must be approved again before runs pick it up, and the stored version itself is left untouched. The restored positions are validated as an update would validate them, so a restore that would bring back a source document the caller cannot read is refused.
name: capability:playbooks.versions.restore
title: playbooks.versions.restore

description: Add up to ten properties (columns) to a matter in a single transaction, under the same rules as properties.create: all of them land or none do, the resulting count must stay within the matter's property limit, every dependency must be a property of this matter, and at most one document-type classifier may exist. Returns the new property ids.
name: capability:properties.batch.create
title: properties.batch.create

description: Add one property (a column) to a matter: its name, value type, and either an AI prompt tool, optionally depending on other columns, or a manual-input tool. An AI column is created stale, so its values are produced by the next run rather than immediately. Refused when the matter is at its property limit, when a dependency is not a property of this matter, or when the matter already has a document-type classifier column.
name: capability:properties.create
title: properties.create

description: Permanently delete one custom property (column) from a matter, with every value stored under it on every document version, plus its cell metadata and list placements. System properties, file properties, and properties another property depends on are refused.
name: capability:properties.delete
title: properties.delete

description: List the property (column) definitions of a matter. Returns each property's id, name, value type (text, single-select, multi-select, date, or int), and status. Use the returned property id with set_field_value to set a document's value for that property.
name: capability:properties.list
title: properties.list

description: Run a column prompt against one document without creating the column or storing anything, so a prompt can be tried before it is saved. Pass the prompt, the value type, the entityId to run it against, any select options, and the columns it depends on. Returns status ready with the generated value, skipped when the dependency values are missing or unusable on that document, unsupported when the document cannot be processed, or empty when the model returned nothing. Consumes AI usage.
name: capability:properties.preview
title: properties.preview

description: Draft or refine a column's extraction prompt with the model, from the column name, value type, select options, a free-text instruction, and optionally the prompt as it stands. Returns one single-line prompt of at most 280 characters and stores nothing. Consumes AI usage.
name: capability:properties.prompt.suggest
title: properties.prompt.suggest

description: Replace one property's name, value type, and tool (an AI prompt with its dependencies, or manual input) in a matter. A change that affects extraction marks the column, and every column that transitively depends on it, stale so the next run recomputes them. Refused on a circular dependency, on a second document-type classifier, on a file property without a manual-input tool, and on a select fallback that is not one of the supplied options. The dependency rows of a playbook-materialized manual column are preserved rather than rewritten. File types cannot be changed to or from another type. Keep the existing type when renaming; use properties.create for a custom column with another value type.
name: capability:properties.update
title: properties.update

description: Read the matter's current hourly or flat-fee billing arrangement. The arrangement field is null for the existing hourly rate-table behavior; call rates.arrangement.update to configure it. Issued invoices retain their own snapshots.
name: capability:rates.arrangement.get
title: rates.arrangement.get

description: Read matter time billing usage: non-void invoice time-line net reservations (including drafts) plus approved unbilled client time, in one currency. Amounts are exact decimal minor-unit strings. Currency mismatch makes cap status unavailable; the summary field is null when no arrangement exists; configure one with rates.arrangement.update. remainingInvoiceCapAmount excludes approved unbilled work; remainingWipCapAmount includes it. No events are emitted by reads.
name: capability:rates.arrangement.summary.get
title: rates.arrangement.summary.get

description: Set the matter's current billing arrangement in integer minor currency units. Hourly supports optional positive amount and minute caps with an alert threshold in basis points; flat fee supplies one amount. Refused for mixed-currency existing charged work or a cap below reserved invoice time. Changes do not change invoice snapshots.
name: capability:rates.arrangement.update
title: rates.arrangement.update

description: Create a rate table, a named set of hourly rates in a single currency, in a matter. Pass isDefault to make it the matter's default, which clears the flag on the previous default; matters have a fixed cap on how many rate tables they may hold. Add the rates themselves with rates.entries.create.
name: capability:rates.create
title: rates.create

description: Permanently delete one rate table from a matter and, with it, every per-user rate line it holds. The matter's default rate table is refused until another table is made the default; time entries already recorded keep the rate they were billed at.
name: capability:rates.delete
title: rates.delete

description: Add one rate line to a rate table: an hourly rate in integer minor currency units, effective from a date and optionally until another. Pass userId for a person-specific rate, role for an organization-role rate, or omit both for the table fallback. Set at most one person or role; optionally pass activityCodeId for an activity-only or person/role plus activity rate. Refused when dates overlap a line for the same selector or userId is not an organization member, or when the table is at its line limit.
name: capability:rates.entries.create
title: rates.entries.create

description: Delete one person, role, or table-default rate line (hourly rate and effective dates) from a rate table, leaving the table and its other lines in place. Use rates.delete to remove the whole table instead.
name: capability:rates.entries.delete
title: rates.entries.delete

description: List the rate lines of one rate table, earliest effective-from first, with cursor pagination. Each line carries the hourly rate in minor currency units, its effective dates, and its person or organization role selector and optional activityCodeId (all null for the table fallback). A rate table that does not exist in this matter returns an empty page rather than an error.
name: capability:rates.entries.list
title: rates.entries.list

description: Change one rate line's hourly rate or effective dates in a rate table. Changing the dates re-checks for overlap against the other lines for the same person, role, or table default and is refused on a conflict; the selector a line applies to cannot be changed here.
name: capability:rates.entries.update
title: rates.entries.update

description: List a matter's rate tables oldest first with cursor pagination, returning each table's name, currency, default flag, and how many rate lines it holds. Use rates.entries.list for the lines themselves and rates.resolve for the rate that actually applies to a user on a date.
name: capability:rates.list
title: rates.list

description: Resolve the effective hourly rate for a user on a given date in a matter, using the default rate table: user plus activity, role plus activity, activity, user, role, then table default. Effective dates apply throughout. Returns the hourly rate in integer minor currency units (e.g. cents) and the currency, or nulls when no rate applies.
name: capability:rates.resolve
title: rates.resolve

description: Rename a rate table, change its currency, or make it the matter's default, which clears the flag on the previous default. Unsetting the flag on the only default table is refused, so a matter that has a default keeps one; a matter whose tables were all created without the flag has none, and rate resolution handles that. Rates already recorded on time entries are not rewritten.
name: capability:rates.update
title: rates.update

description: Copy one built-in report template into the organization so it can be edited in Template Studio and picked like any other template. Pass the built-in's key. The clone keeps the built-in's fill manifest verbatim, so it fills identically, and its name gains a (copy) suffix when a template of that name already exists.
name: capability:reports.builtins.clone
title: reports.builtins.clone

description: Read a report export's status. Completed downloads include a short-lived URL; workspace exports include the created document ID.
name: capability:reports.exports.get
title: reports.exports.get

description: List report exports requested by the current user in a matter, newest first with cursor pagination.
name: capability:reports.exports.list
title: reports.exports.list

description: List built-in and organization report templates available for exporting a matter view.
name: capability:reports.templates.list
title: reports.templates.list

description: Start an asynchronous DOCX or PDF export of a matter view using a selected report template. Returns an export ID to poll.
name: capability:reports.views.export
title: reports.views.export

description: Save a personal named time narrative for reuse across matters in the active organization.
name: capability:saved-time-narratives.create
title: saved-time-narratives.create

description: Delete a personal saved time narrative in the active organization.
name: capability:saved-time-narratives.delete
title: saved-time-narratives.delete

description: List the signed-in user's saved time narratives in the active organization, ordered by name with cursor pagination.
name: capability:saved-time-narratives.list
title: saved-time-narratives.list

description: Update a personal saved time narrative in the active organization.
name: capability:saved-time-narratives.update
title: saved-time-narratives.update

description: Delete your whole search history in the active organization: every search and opened decision or statute it holds. Entries are erased, not hidden; this cannot be undone. Your history in other organizations stays. Pass the scope from `search-history.list` to reject a changed sign-in scope; these fields never select a different owner.
name: capability:search-history.clear
title: search-history.clear

description: Delete one entry from your own search history in the active organization. The entry is erased, not hidden; this cannot be undone. Take the id and scope from `search-history.list`. A changed sign-in scope rejects the request.
name: capability:search-history.delete
title: search-history.delete

description: List your own search history in the active organization, most recently used first: law searches you ran and the decisions and statutes you opened. Each entry is private to you; nobody else in the organization can read it. Pass `kind` to list one kind, `country` to list one jurisdiction's entries, and `cursor` from `nextCursor` for older entries. Delete an entry with `search-history.delete`, or all of it with `search-history.clear`; pass the returned `scope.organizationId` as `expectedOrganizationId` and `scope.userId` as `expectedUserId` on either mutation.
name: capability:search-history.list
title: search-history.list

description: Archive an issuer profile so it is unavailable for new invoices. The retained record remains available for historical references.
name: capability:seller-profiles.archive
title: seller-profiles.archive

description: Create an issuer profile for the active organization. The first active profile becomes the default; later profiles can be made default explicitly. vatPayer (default false) says whether invoices from this issuer charge VAT; it requires a vatId.
name: capability:seller-profiles.create
title: seller-profiles.create

description: Make one active issuer profile the organization's default. An archived profile cannot be selected.
name: capability:seller-profiles.default.update
title: seller-profiles.default.update

description: Read one active issuer profile in the active organization.
name: capability:seller-profiles.get
title: seller-profiles.get

description: List active issuer profiles for the active organization, newest first, with cursor pagination. Bank details are included for billing setup.
name: capability:seller-profiles.list
title: seller-profiles.list

description: Update an active issuer profile in the active organization. Omitted fields stay unchanged; null clears an optional field. A VAT payer (vatPayer: true) must keep a VAT ID.
name: capability:seller-profiles.update
title: seller-profiles.update

description: Accept an inbox signal by taking one of its suggestions. Task and deadline suggestions are created here; for the others the client performs the action and reports what it produced.
name: capability:signals.acceptances.create
title: signals.acceptances.create

description: Assign an open inbox signal to an organization member, or clear the assignment with null.
name: capability:signals.assignments.create
title: signals.assignments.create

description: Dismiss an inbox signal with an optional reason; the reason is kept for tuning the producer that emitted it.
name: capability:signals.dismissals.create
title: signals.dismissals.create

description: Read one inbox signal with its evidence and suggestions; 404 when it is not visible to the caller.
name: capability:signals.get
title: signals.get

description: List inbox signals visible to the caller: open by default, or snoozed or resolved via `view`; filter by matter, origin, severity, or assignment.
name: capability:signals.list
title: signals.list

description: Post a manual request into the inbox: a piece of work for the legal team, optionally scoped to a matter and assigned to a colleague.
name: capability:signals.requests.create
title: signals.requests.create

description: Snooze an inbox signal until a later time; it returns to the open feed once that time passes.
name: capability:signals.snoozes.create
title: signals.snoozes.create

description: List the enabled skills that carry a slash command, shaped for the chat composer's command menu: id, scope, name, description, command, and the full instruction body to insert on pick. Capped at 250 rows and not paginated; use skills.list for the whole catalogue.
name: capability:skills.commands.list
title: skills.commands.list

description: Comment on a character range of one revision of an agent skill, or of a proposal's body. Pass exactly one of revisionId and proposalId; a comment on a proposal is also anchored to the revision that proposal branched from. The quoted source text is captured from the range so the comment survives the text moving on.
name: capability:skills.comments.create
title: skills.comments.create

description: Delete a comment on an agent skill. Only its author or someone who may edit the skill can.
name: capability:skills.comments.delete
title: skills.comments.delete

description: List the comments anchored to an agent skill, oldest first, across its revisions and proposals. Each carries the character range and the quoted text it was written against, and whether it has been resolved.
name: capability:skills.comments.list
title: skills.comments.list

description: Resolve or reopen a comment on an agent skill. Anyone who can see the skill can, not only the comment's author.
name: capability:skills.comments.update
title: skills.comments.update

description: Author an agent skill from text: name, description, instruction body, an optional slash command, and an optional invocation (`auto`, the default: the assistant may use it on its own; `manual`: only when the user invokes it). Team scope requires admin or owner, private scope is your own. Pass `boundWorkspaceId` to bind the skill to one matter (any member who reaches the matter may, for team scope too) or `boundClientId` to bind it to one client (admins and owners only); a bound skill is visible and usable only there, and the binding cannot change later. A command must be lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, must not be one of the reserved commands, and must be free in the organization, as must the skill name. Refused once the per-user or per-organization skill limit is reached. Use skills.upload or skills.from-url.import for a packaged skill instead.
name: capability:skills.create
title: skills.create

description: Permanently delete an agent skill from the organization, with every resource file attached to it. Team skills may only be deleted by an admin or owner and private skills only by their author; bundled skills, which cannot be edited, can still be deleted here.
name: capability:skills.delete
title: skills.delete

description: Discover importable skills from a GitHub repository or SKILL.md URL.
name: capability:skills.discover
title: skills.discover

description: Draft a skill bundle with the model: returns SKILL.md markdown plus up to eight companion files under assets/, references/, scripts/. Pass intent, optionally examples, and, to revise an existing draft, previousDraft with previousResources and feedback. Nothing is stored: pass the result to skills.create and the resource endpoints to keep it. Consumes AI usage.
name: capability:skills.drafts.generate
title: skills.drafts.generate

description: Create an editable draft skill from one of the bundled blueprints, a SKILL.md skeleton with placeholder resource files. The draft is installed disabled and under a fresh slug, so the same blueprint can be used more than once, and stays fully editable afterwards. Team scope requires admin or owner, unless the draft is bound to a matter (`boundWorkspaceId`) the caller reaches; `boundClientId` binds it to one client (admins and owners only). A bound skill is visible and usable only there, and the binding cannot change later.
name: capability:skills.from-blueprint.create
title: skills.from-blueprint.create

description: Fetch and install one agent skill from a URL pointing at a SKILL.md file or a skill package. It is stored with a url origin, so it stays editable afterwards. Importing an unchanged package again returns the skill it installed. The result lists the package files the skill does not keep (skippedFiles: path and reason). Team scope requires admin or owner. To pull several skills out of a repository, use skills.discover and then skills.import instead.
name: capability:skills.from-url.import
title: skills.from-url.import

description: Read one agent skill in full: its instruction body, scope, origin, version, license, compatibility, source URL, slash command, invocation (`auto` or `manual`: whether the assistant may use it on its own), the matter (`boundWorkspaceId`) or client (`boundClientId`) it is bound to, and every resource file with its content. A team skill is readable by every member of the organization, a bound one only by members who reach its matter or client; a private one only by its author.
name: capability:skills.get
title: skills.get

description: Import one or more discovered skills from source URLs into the selected scope. Each installed skill lists the package files it does not keep (skippedFiles: path and reason).
name: capability:skills.import
title: skills.import

description: List the agent skills visible to you, the organization's team skills plus your own private ones, enabled first and then by scope and name, with cursor pagination, alongside the skills shipped with stella (`builtIn`). Instruction bodies come back only for skills that carry a slash command; read one skill in full with skills.get. Each installed skill carries `lastEdit`: who wrote its newest revision and when, or `stella` for an unedited stella starter skill, `unattributed` for other system writes and former members. Every skill carries `invocation`: `auto` when the assistant may use it on its own, `manual` when it runs only on the user's request. An installed skill bound to one matter or client carries `boundWorkspaceId` or `boundClientId`, and is listed only to members who reach it. Also reports whether you may manage team skills.
name: capability:skills.list
title: skills.list

description: Open a draft change proposal against an agent skill, branched from its newest revision. Omit body to start from that revision's text. The skill itself is untouched until someone with edit rights accepts the proposal; bundled skills are refused.
name: capability:skills.proposals.create
title: skills.proposals.create

description: Delete a change proposal for an agent skill, along with the comments anchored to it. The skill and its revisions are untouched. Only the author or someone who may edit the skill can.
name: capability:skills.proposals.delete
title: skills.proposals.delete

description: Turn reviewer comments on an agent skill into a draft change proposal: the model rewrites SKILL.md so each comment is addressed, and the result is stored as a draft branched from the skill's newest revision. Pass commentIds to apply specific comments, or omit it to apply every unresolved comment on that revision. The skill itself is untouched until someone with edit rights accepts the proposal, the comments stay unresolved, and bundled skills are refused. Consumes AI usage.
name: capability:skills.proposals.from-comments.create
title: skills.proposals.from-comments.create

description: Read one change proposal for an agent skill, with its proposed body and the body of the revision it branched from, so the two can be diffed.
name: capability:skills.proposals.get
title: skills.proposals.get

description: List the change proposals raised against an agent skill, newest first and without their bodies. baseIsCurrent reports whether a proposal still branches from the skill's newest revision.
name: capability:skills.proposals.list
title: skills.proposals.list

description: Accept or reject a change proposal for an agent skill that its author has submitted for review (status proposed); a draft is a 409. Accepting writes the proposed body to the skill and records the revision it produced; rejecting leaves the skill untouched. Either way the decision is final. Requires the rights to edit the skill itself.
name: capability:skills.proposals.review
title: skills.proposals.review

description: Edit a change proposal for an agent skill: its proposed body, its summary, or whether it is still a draft or now up for review. Only the author or someone who may edit the skill can, and only until the proposal is decided.
name: capability:skills.proposals.update
title: skills.proposals.update

description: Add one text file to an agent skill at a path such as references/checklist.md. A path already used in the skill is a 409, a skill at its file limit is refused, and bundled skills cannot be edited. Team skills require admin or owner, private ones their author. Use skills.resources.upload for a DOCX or PDF whose text must be extracted first.
name: capability:skills.resources.create
title: skills.resources.create

description: Delete one resource file from an agent skill, addressed by its path; the skill and its other resources are untouched. Bundled skills are read-only and are refused.
name: capability:skills.resources.delete
title: skills.resources.delete

description: Move one file of an agent skill to a new path, leaving its content untouched. A path identical to the old one, a path already used by another file in the same skill, and a bundled skill are all refused.
name: capability:skills.resources.rename
title: skills.resources.rename

description: Rewrite one file of an agent skill with the model, from a free-text instruction and the file's current content. Returns the proposed content without saving it: persist it with skills.resources.update. Consumes AI usage.
name: capability:skills.resources.rewrite
title: skills.resources.rewrite

description: Replace the content of one file of an agent skill, addressed by its path. The path stays as it is; use skills.resources.rename to change it. Bundled skills are read-only, team skills require admin or owner, and private ones their author.
name: capability:skills.resources.update
title: skills.resources.update

description: Read one recorded revision of an agent skill in full, including the instruction body as it stood at that point.
name: capability:skills.revisions.get
title: skills.revisions.get

description: List the recorded revisions of an agent skill, newest first, without their bodies. Every body change records one, including the edits that accepting a proposal makes.
name: capability:skills.revisions.list
title: skills.revisions.list

description: Change an agent skill: enable or disable it, set its invocation (`auto`: the assistant may use it on its own; `manual`: only when the user invokes it), or edit its name, description, instruction body, version, or slash command. Pass command as null to clear it; at least one field is required. Enabling, disabling and the invocation work on any skill you may manage, but editing the content of a bundled skill is refused. A rename derives a new unique slug from the name; a command already taken in the organization is a 409.
name: capability:skills.update
title: skills.update

description: Permanently delete an organization style set and the stored package file behind it. Documents and templates already created from the style set are unaffected, because they copied its styles at creation time.
name: capability:style-sets.delete
title: style-sets.delete

description: Mint a short-lived download URL for one organization style set's stored DOCX package, recording the download in the audit trail. A style set that is unknown or already deleted is a 404.
name: capability:style-sets.download
title: style-sets.download

description: Read one organization style set as editor settings: its name, updatedAt, and the style settings parsed out of the stored DOCX package. Pass that updatedAt back to style-sets.from-editor.update as expectedUpdatedAt so a concurrent edit is not silently overwritten.
name: capability:style-sets.editor.get
title: style-sets.editor.get

description: Create an organization style set from explicit editor settings applied to the built-in stella preset, with no DOCX involved. Returns the new style set's id, name, and updatedAt.
name: capability:style-sets.from-editor.create
title: style-sets.from-editor.create

description: Rewrite one style set's package from explicit editor settings, using its current package as the base, and set its name at the same time. Pass expectedUpdatedAt from style-sets.editor.get so an edit made in the meantime is rejected instead of overwritten.
name: capability:style-sets.from-editor.update
title: style-sets.from-editor.update
